Since 2007 a group of people, consisting of publishers, journalists, editors and academics, come together on a yearly basis, to gather, evaluate and acknowledge the best examples of communication design in our continent. The European Design Awards wraps up with a festival in a different city every year, leading up to the awards ceremony.

id: Fashion (Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp)
title: Fashion (Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp)
tldr: `Bachelor's and Master's Program` in Fashion of Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp
info: 패션은 사회적, 문화적, 예술적, 미학적 생각을 반영한다. 패션은 우리 문화와 경제에서 두드러진 위치를 차지하고, 한 시대를 규정하며, 논쟁적이면서도 혁명적일 수 있다. 그런 의미에서 패션 디자이너는 시대에 개인적인 흔적을 남길 수 있다. 패션 학과는 1963년 Mary Prijot가 세웠다. 그는 드로잉에 큰 비중을 둔 충실한 패션 디자인 학과를 강하게 지지한 인물이었다. 이후 Linda Loppa가 강한 비전과 세계관으로 학과를 발전시키고 높은 창작 기준을 세워 학과를 국제 무대에 올려놓았다. 2007년부터 2022년까지는 Walter Van Beirendonck가 창의성과 순수한 예술적 표현에 날카로운 눈을 두고 학과를 이끌며, 처음부터 세워진 최고의 창작·전문 기준을 지켰다. 2022년부터는 Brandon Wen이 학과의 새 크리에이티브 디렉터로 임명되었다. 그의 에너지와 창의적 비전으로, 매년 열리는 SHOW와 EXPO로 이어지는 학과의 거대한 유산을 계속 이어 갈 것이다. Fashion reflects social, societal, cultural, artistic and aesthetic ideas. It occupies a prominent position in our culture and economy, defines a period and can be both controversial and revolutionary. In this sense, a fashion designer can put a personal stamp on the times. The Fashion Department was founded by Mary Prijot in 1963. She was a great advocate of a fully developed fashion design department with a big focus on drawing. Thereafter, Linda Loppa took over, further developing the department with her strong vision and world view, imposing high creative standards and setting the department on the international map. From 2007 until 2022, Walter Van Beirendonck shaped the department with a sharp eye to creativity and pure artistic expression, always keeping the highest creative and professional standards that had been laid out from the beginning. As from 2022, Brandon Wen has been appointed as the new creative director of theFashion Department. With his energy and creative vision, we will continue the enormous legacy of the department culminating in the yearly SHOW and EXPO.

>
> 패션 학과는 1963년 Mary Prijot가 세웠다. 그는 드로잉에 큰 비중을 둔 충실한 패션 디자인 학과를 강하게 지지한 인물이었다. 이후 Linda Loppa가 강한 비전과 세계관으로 학과를 발전시키고 높은 창작 기준을 세워 학과를 국제 무대에 올려놓았다. 2007년부터 2022년까지는 Walter Van Beirendonck가 창의성과 순수한 예술적 표현에 날카로운 눈을 두고 학과를 이끌며, 처음부터 세워진 최고의 창작·전문 기준을 지켰다. 2022년부터는 Brandon Wen이 학과의 새 크리에이티브 디렉터로 임명되었다. 그의 에너지와 창의적 비전으로, 매년 열리는 SHOW와 EXPO로 이어지는 학과의 거대한 유산을 계속 이어 갈 것이다.
>
> Fashion reflects social, societal, cultural, artistic and aesthetic ideas. It occupies a prominent position in our culture and economy, defines a period and can be both controversial and revolutionary. In this sense, a fashion designer can put a personal stamp on the times.
>
> The Fashion Department was founded by Mary Prijot in 1963. She was a great advocate of a fully developed fashion design department with a big focus on drawing. Thereafter, Linda Loppa took over, further developing the department with her strong vision and world view, imposing high creative standards and setting the department on the international map. From 2007 until 2022, Walter Van Beirendonck shaped the department with a sharp eye to creativity and pure artistic expression, always keeping the highest creative and professional standards that had been laid out from the beginning. As from 2022, Brandon Wen has been appointed as the new creative director of theFashion Department. With his energy and creative vision, we will continue the enormous legacy of the department culminating in the yearly SHOW and EXPO.

info: 고급 사진 교육에서 패션 사진은 상상력 있는 서사, 문화적 관련성, 장난스러운 전복성, 지난 30년간 '순수 예술' 사진에 끼친 깊은 영향에도 불구하고, 진지하게 고려할 가치가 없고 피상적이며 스타일과 상업에 오염되었다고 여겨지는 경우가 너무 많다. MPS 패션 사진 프로그램은 패션 사진의 서사적, 개념적, 문화적 하위 텍스트에 몰입하고 뉴욕 패션과 패션 사진계의 주요 인물과 직접 교류하며, 더 창의적이고 독창적인 작품군을 만들고자 하는 기술적으로 숙련된 사진가를 위한 엄격한 1년 집중 과정이다. At the upper levels of photographic education, fashion photography is too often thought of as unworthy of serious consideration, superficial, and corrupted by style and commerce, despite its imaginative narrative, cultural relevance, playful subversion, and its profound influence on “fine art” photography of the past 30 years. The MPS Fashion Photography program is a rigorous one-year intensive program for the technologically proficient photographer who wants to develop a more creative and original body of work through an immersion in the narrative, conceptual, and cultural subtext of fashion photography, and with direct engagement with leading figures in fashion and fashion photography in New York City.

> MPS 패션 사진 프로그램은 패션 사진의 서사적, 개념적, 문화적 하위 텍스트에 몰입하고 뉴욕 패션과 패션 사진계의 주요 인물과 직접 교류하며, 더 창의적이고 독창적인 작품군을 만들고자 하는 기술적으로 숙련된 사진가를 위한 엄격한 1년 집중 과정이다.
>
> At the upper levels of photographic education, fashion photography is too often thought of as unworthy of serious consideration, superficial, and corrupted by style and commerce, despite its imaginative narrative, cultural relevance, playful subversion, and its profound influence on “fine art” photography of the past 30 years.
>
> The MPS Fashion Photography program is a rigorous one-year intensive program for the technologically proficient photographer who wants to develop a more creative and original body of work through an immersion in the narrative, conceptual, and cultural subtext of fashion photography, and with direct engagement with leading figures in fashion and fashion photography in New York City.

title: Felipe Rocha
tldr: `Founder & Creative Director` of PORTO ROCHA
info: Felipe Rocha는 비즈니스, 아이덴티티, 문화의 교차점에서 브랜드를 만들어 온 18년 이상 경력의 디자이너이자 크리에이티브 디렉터다. 그의 작업은 글로벌 상업·문화 맥락에 걸쳐 있으며 기업·기관과 파트너가 되어 대규모에서 공감을 얻는 브랜드를 만든다. PORTO ROCHA를 공동 설립하기 전에는 Spotify와 Sagmeister & Walsh에서 일했고, 이탈리아 Fabrica에서 《COLORS》 매거진 작업을 했다. 국제그래픽연맹(AGI) 회원이다. Felipe Rocha is a designer and creative director with over 18 years of experience shaping brands at the intersection of business, identity, and culture. His work spans global commercial and cultural contexts, partnering with companies and institutions to build brands that resonate at scale. Prior to co-founding PORTO ROCHA, he held roles at Spotify and Sagmeister & Walsh, and worked at Fabrica in Italy on COLORS magazine. He is a member of the Alliance Graphique Internationale.

title: Fendi
tldr: 1925년 Adele와 Edoardo Fendi가 시작한 이탈리아 패션 하우스(LVMH 소속)
info: Fendi Srl은 모피, 기성복, 가죽 제품, 신발, 향수, 안경, 시계, 액세서리를 만드는 이탈리아 럭셔리 패션 하우스다. 1925년 패션 디자이너 Edoardo Fendi와 Adele Casagrande가 로마에서 설립했으며 모피, 모피 액세서리, 가죽 제품으로 알려져 있다. 2001년 프랑스 그룹 LVMH의 ‘패션 & 가죽 제품’ 부문이 되었다. 본사는 로마의 Palazzo della Civiltà Italiana에 있다. Fendi Srl is an Italian luxury fashion house producing fur, ready-to-wear, leather goods, shoes, fragrances, eyewear, timepieces and accessories. Founded in Rome in 1925 by fashion designers Edoardo Fendi and Adele Casagrande, Fendi is known for its fur, fur accessories, and leather goods. id: Film and TV School of the Academy of Performing Arts in Prague
title: Film and TV School of the Academy of Performing Arts in Prague
tldr: `Art School` based in Prague
info: 프라하 공연예술아카데미 영화·TV 학교(FAMU)는 프라하 공연예술아카데미(DAMU, FAMU, HAMU)의 세 학부 가운데 하나이자 유럽에서 다섯 번째로 오래된 영화 학교다. 학생들의 영화는 매년 세계 영화제에서 수십 개의 상을 받는다. FAMU의 교육과정은 실습과 이론을 결합하고 있어, 학생들은 영화, 텔레비전, 사진, 뉴미디어의 모든 직종에서 일하는 데 필요한 포괄적인 기술과 지식을 얻는다. 1960년대 초 FAMU는 훗날 체코슬로바키아 뉴웨이브로 유명해진 젊은 예술가들의 인큐베이터였다. 그것은 당시까지 세계 영화에 대한 가장 큰 기여였고, 체코슬로바키아는 외국어영화상 오스카를 두 번 받았다. Film and TV School of Academy of Performing Arts in Prague (FAMU) is one of the three faculties of the Academy of Performing Arts in Prague (DAMU, FAMU, HAMU) and the fifth oldest film school in Europe. Its students' films are recognized with dozens of awards at film festivals around the world every year. FAMU's study programmes combine both practical and theoretical approaches, thanks to which students acquire a comprehensive set of skills and knowledge needed to work in all professions of film, television, photography and new media. In early 1960’s, it served as an incubator for young artists who subsequently became famous as the Czechoslovak New Wave. It was the greatest contribution to the world’s cinematography until then, and it earned Czechoslovakia – inter alia – two Oscars for Best Foreign Films.

title: Fine Arts, Painting (Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp)
tldr: `Bachelor's and Master's Program` in fine art (painting) of Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp
info: 회화는 수 세기 동안 존재해 왔고 여러 번 스스로를 새롭게 해 왔다. 디지털 시각 문화의 시대에 회화는 독특한 위치를 차지한다. 회화를 택한다는 것은 대단히 풍부한 전통과 동시대적 가능성을 지닌 느린 매체를 택하는 것이다. 아카데미의 회화 프로그램은 전문적 기술과 개인적인 예술 경험이 만나는 접점에 있다. 회화의 풍부한 역사에 대한 깊은 지식에서 출발해, 학생들은 전문적이고 경험 많은 예술가 팀의 지도 아래 자신만의 시각 언어를 키우도록 권장된다. 동료 학생도 여기서 결정적인 역할을 한다. Painting has been around for centuries and has reinvented itself several times. In an age of digital visual culture, it occupies a unique position. Choosing for painting is choosing a slow medium with a particularly rich tradition and contemporary potential. The Academy’s Painting programme is situated at the interface between professional skill and personal artistic experience. Starting from a profound knowledge of the rich history of painting, students are encouraged to develop their own visual language under the guidance of a team of professional and experienced artists. Fellow students also have a crucial role in this.

title: Franck Durand
tldr: `Creative Director` of Atelier Franck Durand, L'ÉTIQUETTE
info: Franck Durand는 패션, 뷰티, 라이프스타일을 전문으로 하는 크리에이티브 디자인 스튜디오 Atelier Franck Durand의 창립자이자 크리에이티브 디렉터다. 이 아틀리에는 Balmain, Isabel Marant 등의 패션 캠페인을 맡고 있다. 2014년 Durand는 미국 여행 매거진 《Holiday》를 되살렸다. 유쾌한 그래픽 디자인과 실험적인 사진으로 유명했던 이 잡지는 1977년 폐간된 원판의 저널리즘적 모험의 감각을 담아내려 한다. 《Holiday》는 영어로 발행되지만 Durand는 “그 심장은 프랑스적”이라고 말했으며, 기획·디자인·제작하는 팀은 파리에 있다. 재창간 이후 《Holiday》는 의류·굿즈 라인 Holiday Boileau와 파리 16구의 카페로도 확장했다. Durand는 20세에 당대 가장 영향력 있는 아트 디렉터 중 한 명인 Marc Ascoli 밑에서 아트 디렉션 경력을 시작했다. 29세에 이 관계가 파트너십으로 이어졌고, 2004년 Atelier Franck Durand를 만들었다. 이 아틀리에에서 수많은 캠페인의 아트 디렉션을 맡았고 Inez & Vinoodh, Alasdair McLellan, Karim Sadli, Collier Schorr 같은 주요 사진가들과 일했다. 《i-D》의 에디토리얼과 2013 봄·여름 시즌부터 Balmain의 수많은 룩북을 아트 디렉팅했다. Franck Durand is the founder and creative director of Atelier Franck Durand, a creative design studio specialising in fashion, beauty and lifestyle. The Atelier is responsible for fashion campaigns for the likes of Balmain and Isabel Marant . In 2014, Durand revived the American travel magazine. Holiday. Renowned for its playful graphic design and experimental photography, Durand’s revamp aims to capture the sense of journalistic adventure of its original version that folded in 1977. Holiday is published in English, but Durand has commented that “its heart is French,” with the team who conceive, design and produce it based in Paris. Since relaunching, Holiday has also expanded into clothing and merchandise line Holiday Boileau and a café situated in Paris' 16th arondissement. Durand began his career in art direction at the age of 20 working for Marc Ascoli, one of the most influential art directors of his generation. At 29, this working relationship led to a partnership. In 2004, he created Atelier Franck Durand. Under this atelier he has provided art direction for numerous campaigns and worked with major photographers including Inez & Vinoodh, Alasdair McLellan , Karim Sadli and Collier Schorr . He has art directed editorials for i-D and numerous lookbooks for Balmain since Spring/Summer 2013. He is married to Vogue Paris Editor-in-Chief Emmanuelle Alt .

title: Frank Gehry
tldr: 구겐하임 빌바오, 월트 디즈니 콘서트 홀로 알려진 포스트모던 건축가
info: Frank Owen Gehry(본명 Goldberg, 1929년 2월 28일 ~ 2025년 12월 5일)는 포스트모던한 설계와 비정형적인 형태·재료의 사용으로 알려진 캐나다계 미국인 건축가이자 디자이너다. 산타모니카의 자택을 비롯한 그의 건물 여럿이 명소가 되었다. 대표작으로 스페인의 구겐하임 미술관 빌바오, 로스앤젤레스의 월트 디즈니 콘서트 홀, 파리의 루이 비통 재단이 있으며, 티타늄과 스테인리스 스틸 같은 혁신적인 재료와 조각적이고 물결치는 외관이 특징이다. Frank Owen Gehry ( GAIR-ee; né Goldberg; February 28, 1929 – December 5, 2025) was a Canadian-American architect and designer known for his postmodern designs and use of unconventional forms and materials. A number of his buildings, including his private residence in Santa Monica, California, have become attractions. His most famous works include the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao in Spain, the Walt Disney Concert Hall in Los Angeles, and the Louis Vuitton Foundation in Paris. These buildings are characterized by their sculptural, often undulating exteriors and innovative use of materials such as titanium and stainless steel.

A number of his buildings, including his private residence in Santa Monica, California, have become attractions. His most famous works include the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao in Spain, the Walt Disney Concert Hall in Los Angeles, and the Louis Vuitton Foundation in Paris. title: Fred North
tldr: Koto 베를린 스튜디오의 크리에이티브 디렉터
info: Fred는 우리 베를린 스튜디오의 크리에이티브 디렉터다. Airbnb, Backmarket, Coca-Cola 등의 브랜드와 협업했고, 이전에는 DesignStudio에서 프리미어리그, Deliveroo 같은 클라이언트와 일했다. Fred는 독일어를 꽤 하며, 스티븐 제라드보다 프리미어리그 트로피를 더 많이 들어 올렸다. Fred is Creative Director of our Berlin studio. He has partnered with brands including Airbnb, Backmarket, and Coca-Cola, and previously worked at DesignStudio with clients like the Premier League and Deliveroo. Fred speaks a fair bit of German – and has lifted the Premier League trophy more times than Steven Gerrard.

> We are Ashley Govers and Jurjen Versteeg and since 2013 we are From Form, an independent creative studio for film and design.

As a duo, we work from idea to execution out of our Rotterdam-based studio (NL) where we often paint, build, and film. Our commercial and independent projects include short films, campaigns, commercials, film titles, graphic design, photography, and animation.

We love to build worlds that play with the real and imaginative, placing a strong focus on art direction and carefully arranged colours & compositions. As a result, our work is defined by a playful and cinematic approach with a love for the analog and imperfect.

title: Game Art (Los Angeles Film School)
tldr: `Bachelor's Program` in game art of Los Angeles Film School
info: 비디오 게임의 세계는 창작자인 여러분에게서 시작됩니다. 3D 모델링, 엔진 통합, 애니메이션으로 내 창작물을 비디오 게임에 담고 디지털 아트에 생명을 불어넣는 법을 배우세요. 게임 아트 전공으로 꿈의 가상 세계를 짓기 시작하세요. 실습 중심 교과과정으로 학생들은 기술 역량을 높이고 향상된 기술을 선택한 직업에 적용합니다. 학생으로서 캐릭터 제작부터 게임용 환경 구축까지 애니메이션 과정의 모든 단계를 접하게 됩니다. The world of video gaming begins with you, the creator. Learn how to incorporate your creations into video games and bring your digital art to life through 3D modeling, engine integration and animation. Start building your dream virtual worlds with our Game Art concentration. Our hands-on curriculum allows students to improve their technical abilities and apply those enhanced skills to their chosen profession. As a student, you’ll be exposed to every stage of the animation process from character creation to building environments for games.

title: Game Arts, BFA (Pratt Institute)
tldr: `Bachelor's Program` in Game Arts of Pratt Institute
info: 게임은 복잡한 아이디어와 시스템, 그리고 우리가 서로·공동체와 관계 맺는 방식을 탐구합니다. 학생은 게임을 처음부터 만드는 법을 배우며, 놀이로 사람들을 잇는 창발적 서사와 세계를 연구하고 설계하고 개발합니다. 독립 게임 제작, AAA 스튜디오, 게임 인접 분야, 혹은 독립 예술가로 일할 기량과 개인의 목소리, 자신감을 얻으세요. As a student, you will learn how to create games from the ground up, researching, designing, and developing emergent narratives and worlds that connect people through play. Gain the skills, personal voice, and confidence to work in independent game creation, AAA studios, game-adjacent fields, or as an independent artist.

title: Game Design and Animation (Toronto Film School)
tldr: `Diploma Program` in game design and animation of Toronto Film School
info: 현역 게임 제작자에게 직접 배우며 캐릭터와 세계를 구상하고, 디자인하고, 모델링하고, 애니메이션으로 만드세요. 이 몰입형 프로그램에서 업계 표준 도구와 작업 흐름을 직접 경험합니다. 인터랙티브 엔터테인먼트는 빠르게 진화하므로 앞서 나가세요. 나만의 이야기, 캐릭터, 세계를 모델링하고, 스크립트를 쓰고, 프로그래밍하고, 디자인하고, 애니메이션으로 만드세요. 모션 캡처 기술을 탐구하고 최신 AI 작업 흐름을 배웁니다. Conceive, design, model, and animate characters and worlds as you learn directly from working game creators. This immersive program gives you hands-on experience with industry-standard tools and workflows. Interactive entertainment evolves fast, so stay ahead. Model, script, program, design and animate your own stories, characters and worlds. Explore motion capture technology and learn the latest AI workflows.

tldr: `Award` presented in Shenzhen by Shenzhen Graphic Design Association
info: GDC Award는 1992년 설립 이후 2년마다 열리며 최고의 디자인을 기리고 창의적인 디자이너를 격려합니다. '중국 디자이너들 사이의 최고 디자인상'에서 '세계에서 가장 중요한 디자인상 중 하나'로 성장했습니다. 선전그래픽디자인협회(SGDA)가 기획·운영하는 비영리 전문 협회 행사입니다. GDC Award runs every other year to praise and recommend the best designs with an aim to encourage creative designers since its foundation in 1992. GDC developed from “a top design award among Chinese designers” to “one of the most important global design awards”. GDC is curated and operated by Shenzhen Graphic Design Association (SGDA), a non-profit professional design association.

She has led brand identity and exhibition design for Cooper Hewitt, Brooklyn Museum, Dia Art Foundation, The Clark, and the Studio Museum in Harlem; and directed product development for Knoll, Maharam, and Tarkett. Her clients include Target, Starbucks, Instagram, Nike, Tiffany & Co., Intuit, Hyundai Motor Group, Tom Ford, and Malin + Goetz. She has been a visiting critic at Rhode Island School of Design, Parsons School of Design, MICA, The Cooper Hewitt, and Yale School of Art. She holds a B.F.A from Rhode Island School of Design.

title: Giorgia Lupi
info: Giorgia Lupi is an award-winning information designer whose work synthesizes data and storytelling in innovative ways to create unique and singular brand expressions.
rawContent:
>[!tldr] tl;dr
>

> [!Info]
> Giorgia Lupi is an award-winning information designer whose work synthesizes data and storytelling in innovative ways to create unique and singular brand expressions.

In her practice, she designs engaging data-driven visual narratives across print, digital and environmental media that create new insight and appreciation of people, ideas, and organizations. Her vibrant and inspiring design work empowers leading global organizations to achieve their mission through data-driven storytelling and reflects her belief that data has the capacity to make us all more human—advancing our intelligence, engagement, and delight.

One of the most lauded designers of her generation and a prominent voice in the field of data design, Lupi was the 2022 recipient of the National Design Award from the Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum, and the first data visualization practitioner ever to be named in its communication design category. In 2022 she also received an honorary doctorate from the Maryland Institute College of Art.

Across her career, Lupi has built rich, visually driven experiences around data for international clients such as Google, the Gates Foundation, Verizon, IBM, Deloitte and Starbucks. Recent cultural clients include MoMA, TED, Triennale Milano Design Museum and Getty Museum. She has designed custom data visualizations for national and international publications like The New York Times, Wired, Popular Science, Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists and Italy’s Corriere della Sera. A proponent of using data to help bring awareness to some of the world’s most pressing problems, non-profit clients and causes include the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, Knight Foundation, World Health Organization and United Nations. 

Lupi was born in Italy and received her Master’s degree in architecture from Università di Ferrara and her PhD from Politecnico di Milano, where she focused on information mapping. In 2011, she co-founded Accurat, an acclaimed data-driven research, design and innovation firm with offices in Milan and New York. She joined Pentagram as a partner in 2019.

Her work is part of the permanent collection of the Museum of Modern Art and she has been commissioned for original art installations also by MoMA, Museum of the City of New York, New York Botanical Garden and TED. A former MIT Media Lab Director’s Fellow, she is a member of the World Economic Forum's Global Future Council on New Metrics and a Fellow of the RSA. 

Her TED Talk on her humanistic approach to data has over one million views. She has published four books: [_Speak Data_](https://www.pentagram.com/work/speak-data) (Princeton Architectural Press, 2025), exploring data as a language with a range of perspectives from experts across disciplines; [_This Is Me and Only Me_](https://www.pentagram.com/work/this-is-me-and-only-me) (Corraini Edizioni, 2024), a children’s book introducing the concept of data to kids; [_Observe, Collect, Draw! A Visual Journal_](https://www.pentagram.com/work/observe-collect-draw) (Princeton Architectural Press, 2018), a guided journal for collecting visual data; and [_Dear Data_](https://www.pentagram.com/work/dear-data) (Princeton Architectural Press, 2016), exploring the details of daily life through hand-drawn visual data. Lupi has been featured in international media including The New York Times, The New Yorker, The Guardian, The Washington Post, NPR, BBC, T Magazine, Vogue and Vanity Fair.

title: Giorgio Armani
tldr: Armani 패션 하우스를 설립한 이탈리아 패션 디자이너
info: Giorgio Armani(1934년 7월 11일 ~ 2025년 9월 4일)는 이탈리아의 패션 디자이너이자 럭셔리 패션 하우스 Armani의 창립자다. 동시대 패션에서 가장 영향력 있는 인물 중 하나로 널리 평가받는다. Cerruti 1881과의 작업으로 먼저 인정받았고 1975년 자신의 레이블을 설립했다. 특히 재킷과 정장에서 미니멀하고 해체적인 실루엣으로 알려졌으며, 이는 남성과 여성의 우아함을 동시대적으로 재정의했다고 평가된다. 레드 카펫 패션을 중심으로 셀러브리티 스타일을 형성하는 데도 핵심적인 역할을 했다. 2000년대 초반에는 가장 성공한 이탈리아 디자이너로 인정받았고, 브랜드는 음악, 스포츠, 럭셔리 호텔로까지 확장되었다. Giorgio Armani (Italian: [ˈdʒordʒo arˈmaːni]; 11 July 1934 – 4 September 2025) was an Italian fashion designer and founder of the Armani luxury fashion house. Widely regarded as among the most influential designers in contemporary fashion, Armani initially gained recognition for his work with fashion house Cerruti 1881, before founding his own label in 1975. He became known for minimalist, deconstructed silhouettes—especially his jackets and suits—which are said to have redefined masculine and feminine elegance in a contemporary form. Armani also played a pivotal role in shaping celebrity style, particularly red-carpet fashion. By the early 2000s, he was recognized as the most successful Italian designer, with his brand expanding into music, sport, and luxury hotels. Born in Piacenza, Armani grew up during World War II in modest circumstances and initially pursued medical studies at the University of Milan before leaving to serve in the Italian Army. After his military service, Armani began his career in fashion as a window dresser and sales clerk at La Rinascente in Milan, later designing menswear for Nino Cerruti while freelancing for multiple manufacturers. In 1973, he partnered with Sergio Galeotti to open a design office and in 1975 they founded Giorgio Armani S.p.A., launching men's and women's ready-to-wear collections. Armani expanded his brand globally, introducing several lines including Emporio Armani, Armani Junior and AX Armani Exchange, while also establishing a presence in cosmetics, perfumes and home furnishings. His work in costume design for over 100 films, notably American Gigolo (1980), helped cement his international reputation. Beyond fashion, Armani ventured into hotels, sports and music, including the Armani Hotel in Dubai, designing uniforms for Olympic and professional sports teams and curating Emporio Armani Caffè music compilations. He was an advocate for ethical practices, including banning underweight models in 2007 and promoting sustainable fashion initiatives. Armani maintained a private personal life, including a long-term partnership with Galeotti until the latter's death in 1985.

Cerruti 1881과의 작업으로 먼저 인정받았고 1975년 자신의 레이블을 설립했다. 특히 재킷과 정장에서 미니멀하고 해체적인 실루엣으로 알려졌으며, 이는 남성과 여성의 우아함을 동시대적으로 재정의했다고 평가된다. 레드 카펫 패션을 중심으로 셀러브리티 스타일을 형성하는 데도 핵심적인 역할을 했다. 2000년대 초반에는 가장 성공한 이탈리아 디자이너로 인정받았고, 브랜드는 음악, 스포츠, 럭셔리 호텔로까지 확장되었다. > > Giorgio Armani (Italian: [ˈdʒordʒo arˈmaːni]; 11 July 1934 – 4 September 2025) was an Italian fashion designer and founder of the Armani luxury fashion house. Widely regarded as among the most influential designers in contemporary fashion, Armani initially gained recognition for his work with fashion house Cerruti 1881, before founding his own label in 1975. He became known for minimalist, deconstructed silhouettes—especially his jackets and suits—which are said to have redefined masculine and feminine elegance in a contemporary form. Armani also played a pivotal role in shaping celebrity style, particularly red-carpet fashion. By the early 2000s, he was recognized as the most successful Italian designer, with his brand expanding into music, sport, and luxury hotels. > > Born in Piacenza, Armani grew up during World War II in modest circumstances and initially pursued medical studies at the University of Milan before leaving to serve in the Italian Army. After his military service, Armani began his career in fashion as a window dresser and sales clerk at La Rinascente in Milan, later designing menswear for Nino Cerruti while freelancing for multiple manufacturers. In 1973, he partnered with Sergio Galeotti to open a design office and in 1975 they founded Giorgio Armani S.p.A., launching men's and women's ready-to-wear collections. Armani expanded his brand globally, introducing several lines including Emporio Armani, Armani Junior and AX Armani Exchange, while also establishing a presence in cosmetics, perfumes and home furnishings. His work in costume design for over 100 films, notably American Gigolo (1980), helped cement his international reputation. > > Beyond fashion, Armani ventured into hotels, sports and music, including the Armani Hotel in Dubai, designing uniforms for Olympic and professional sports teams and curating Emporio Armani Caffè music compilations. He was an advocate for ethical practices, including banning underweight models in 2007 and promoting sustainable fashion initiatives. Armani maintained a private personal life, including a long-term partnership with Galeotti until the latter's death in 1985. > [!Summary] > | | | > |---|---| > |Born|11 July 1934

title: Givenchy
tldr: 1952년 Hubert de Givenchy가 설립한 파리의 프랑스 럭셔리 패션 하우스, LVMH 소속
info: Givenchy는 프랑스의 럭셔리 패션·향수 하우스다. 오트 쿠튀르와 기성복, 액세서리, Parfums Givenchy의 향수와 화장품 브랜드를 아우른다. 하우스 오브 지방시는 1952년 디자이너 Hubert de Givenchy가 설립했고, 프랑스 오트 쿠튀르·프레타포르테 연합(Chambre Syndicale)의 회원이며 럭셔리 그룹 LVMH가 소유한다. Givenchy is a French luxury fashion and perfume house. It houses the brand of haute couture and ready-to-wear clothing, accessories, perfumes, and cosmetics of Parfums Givenchy. The House of Givenchy was founded in 1952 by designer Hubert de Givenchy and is a member of the Chambre Syndicale de la Haute Couture et du Prêt-à-Porter. It is owned by luxury conglomerate LVMH.

title: GLAMOUR (Magazine)
tldr: 1939년 뉴욕에서 창간한 미국의 여성 라이프스타일 매거진
info: 거의 85년 동안 Glamour는 여성들이 관심을 두는 주제를 둘러싼 대화를 이끌어 왔고, 그 주제들은 그 어느 때보다 다양하고 복잡하며 흥미진진하다. 우리는 패션, 뷰티, 웰니스, 대중문화, 육아, 정치가 교차하는 영역에 포용적이고 접근 가능한 길을 제공하는 것을 자부한다. 모든 미디어 브랜드가 클릭, 시간, 댓글, 좋아요를 두고 경쟁하는 세상에서, 소음을 뚫고 독창적이면서도 진정성 있는 콘텐츠를 전하는 것은 양보할 수 없는 일이다. 우리는 모든 사람이 환영받고 식탁에 자리를 얻도록 초대받는 평평한 운동장을 만들고 있지만, 잘 아는 주제나 강한 의견이 있는 주제에 대해서는 권위 있게 말하는 것으로 알려져 있다. 그것은 미국의 유급휴가 법제화(우리가 앞장서 온 이슈)를 위해 쉼 없이 일하고, 성형수술, 체외수정과 대리모, 전통적인 미의 기준 같은 이른바 금기 주제에 대해 솔직하고 열린 태도로 말하는 것을 뜻한다. 또한 독자에게 무엇을 살지, 무엇을 입을지, 무엇을 볼지, 어떻게 스스로를 옹호할지, 판단 없이 어떻게 부모 노릇을 할지 등 서비스와 신뢰할 만한 추천을 제공하는 것도 뜻한다. For nearly 85 years Glamour has been leading the conversation about the topics women are invested in, which are more diverse, complex, and exciting than ever. We pride ourselves on offering inclusive and accessible access into the intersecting orbits of fashion, beauty, wellness, pop culture, parenting, and politics. In a world where every media brand is competing for clicks, time, comments, and likes, it’s a nonnegotiable to be able to cut through the noise and deliver content that’s not only unique but authentic. We’re creating a level playing field where all are welcome and invited to have a seat at the table, but we’re known to speak with authority on topics we’re well-versed in or have strong opinions about. That means working tirelessly to pass paid leave in the US (an issue we’ve been at the forefront of), speaking honestly and openly about so-called taboo topics including plastic surgery, IVF and surrogacy, and traditional beauty standards. It also means offering service and trusted recommendations to our readers in the form of what to buy, what to wear, what to watch, how to advocate for yourself, how to parent without judgment, and more.

title: Goldsmiths University of London
tldr: `University` based in London
info: 지난 200년이 넘도록 여러 세대의 학생들이 Goldsmiths 부지에서 교육을 받아 왔다. 1792년 카운터 힐 아카데미가 뉴크로스에서, 데트퍼드의 증류업자 윌리엄 구드하우가 지은 집에 문을 열었다. 이후 왕립 해군학교가 이 부지를 사들여 1843년 지금의 리처드 호가트 빌딩을 지었다. 골드스미스 조합(Worshipful Company of Goldsmiths)이 학교를 인수해 1891년 '골드스미스 조합 기술·여가 학원'으로 다시 열었고, 20세기에 들어 조합은 이 학원을 런던 대학교에 넘겼다. 이때 Goldsmiths College로 이름이 바뀌며 Goldsmiths의 현대가 시작되었다. For more than 200 years, generations of students have received an education here on the site of Goldsmiths. In 1792 the Counter Hill Academy opened its doors in New Cross, in a house built by Deptford distiller, William Goodhew. The Royal Naval School then bought the site, building what is now our Richard Hoggart Building in 1843. The Worshipful Company of Goldsmiths acquired the school and reopened it in 1891 as The Goldsmiths’ Company’s Technical and Recreative Institute. With the dawn of the twentieth century, the Company handed over the Institute to the University of London. It was re-christened Goldsmiths College and the modern era of Goldsmiths had begun.

title: Grace Wales Bonner
tldr: 런던 레이블 Wales Bonner를 이끌며 Hermès 남성복 디렉터에 임명된 영국 디자이너
info: Grace Wales Bonner는 영국의 패션 디자이너다. 그의 디자인은 스포츠웨어, 테일러링, 폭넓은 문화 연구를 결합한다. 2014년 런던 기반 레이블 Wales Bonner를 설립했으며, 처음에는 남성복을 전문으로 했다. 2025년 Véronique Nichanian의 후임으로 Hermès 남성복 라인의 크리에이티브 디렉터에 임명되어, 주요 럭셔리 하우스를 이끄는 최초의 흑인 여성이 되었다. Hermès에서의 첫 컬렉션은 2027년 1월 공개될 예정이다. Grace Wales Bonner is an English fashion designer. Her designs blend sportswear, tailoring and broad cultural research. In 2014, she founded the London-based label Wales Bonner, originally specializing in menswear. In 2025, she was appointed creative director of the Hermès menswear line, succeeding Véronique Nichanian, and becoming the first woman of Black heritage to lead a major luxury fashion house. Wales Bonner's first collection for Hermès is set to be shown in January 2027.

id: Graphic Design (Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp)
title: Graphic Design (Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp)
tldr: `Bachelor's and Master's Program` in Graphic Design of Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp
info: 그래픽 디자인은 우리를 둘러싼 세계와 너무 깊이 얽혀 있어서, 주변의 거의 모든 것이 누군가에 의해 디자인되었다는 사실을 우리는 더 이상 보지 못하곤 한다. 그래서 그래픽 디자인은 (시각적·텍스트) 언어의 전달, 조직, 소통을 주로 다루는 매우 다재다능한 실천이다. 안트베르펜 왕립미술아카데미의 그래픽 디자인 프로그램은 눈에 보이는 언어로 소통하는 다양한 방식에 대한 깊이 있는 지식을 제공한다. 학과는 그래픽 디자인 실천의 기초가 되는 여섯 가지 기본 과목, 곧 편집, 이미지, 인터랙션, 타이포그래피, 드로잉, 이론을 중심으로 구성되어 있다. 학습 과정은 놀이 같으면서도 개념적이며 다양한 매체와 기법으로 접근하고, 북 디자인, 출판, 일러스트레이션, 사진, 영화, 설치, 소프트웨어, 글쓰기에 걸쳐 (그리고 그 너머에서) 개인적인 실험을 늘 장려한다. Graphic design is so intertwined with the world around us that we often no longer see that just about everything in our surroundings was designed by someone. This makes Graphic Design a very versatile practice, primarily concerned with the transmission, organisation and communication of (visual and textual) language. The Graphic Design programme of the Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp provides an in-depth knowledge of the different ways in which we can communicate through visible language. The department is structured around the teaching of six basic subjects fundamental to a graphic design practice: editing, image, interaction, typography, drawing and theory. The learning process is both playful and conceptual, approached through a variety of media and techniques, always encouraging personal experimentation across (and beyond) book design, publishing, illustration, photography, film, installation, software and writing.

title: Graphic Design (The Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT))
tldr: `Bachelor's Program` in graphic design of The Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT)
info: 이 프로그램은 깊이를 요구하고, 사고에 도전하며, 다양한 플랫폼에서 소통하는 역량을 넓힌다. 인문·예술의 다학제적 관점에서 디자인에 접근해, 사회·문화 이슈를 파악하고 대응하게 한다. 더 나은 세상을 디자인하자. 디자인 기술을 익힐 뿐 아니라 비판적 사고, 사회적 인식, 여러 플랫폼에 걸친 소통 능력을 요구하는 개인의 목소리를 다듬는다. 편집 디자인, 인터랙티브 웹 디자인, 경험 디자인(전시와 사인), 키네틱 타이포그래피, 고급 타이포그래피, 기업 아이덴티티 시스템, 모션 그래픽, 미술사를 공부한다. 업계 후원 공모전에 참여하고 필수 인턴십으로 경험을 쌓으며, 시니어 논문 프로젝트와 심사 디자인 전시로 마무리한다. This program demands depth, challenges thinking, and expands your ability to communicate on diverse platforms. It approaches design from the multidisciplinary perspective of the arts and humanities, allowing you to identify and respond to social and cultural issues. Design a better world. You’ll not only master design skills, but also hone a personal voice that requires critical thinking, social awareness, and the ability to communicate across an array of platforms. Topics of study include editorial design, interactive web design, experiential design (exhibitions and signs), and kinetic typography, along with advanced typography, corporate identity systems, motion graphics, and art history. You’ll also participate in industry-sponsored competitions and gain experience through a required internship. The program concludes with a senior thesis project and a juried design exhibition.

Throughout the program you gain a strong understanding of the design principles, theories of communication and strategies for problem solving. The core Graphic Design curriculum encompasses a range of analytical, formal, sensory and technical design experiences. Sophomores begin exploring visual principles of form, image, color and typography. Conceptual thinking in areas such as communication theory, visual systems and information design forms the focus of the junior year.

id: Guildhall School of Music and Drama
title: Guildhall School of Music and Drama
tldr: `Art School` based in London
info: Guildhall 스쿨은 열정이 목적과 만나는 곳이다. 우리는 런던 시티의 중심에 있는 상징적인 최신 시설에서 음악, 연극, 제작·디자인 분야의 세계적 수준의 전문 교육을 제공한다. 150년 가까이 무대와 스크린, 그리고 무대 뒤에서 성공적인 길을 개척한 수많은 재능 있는 공연자와 예술가의 기량과 경력을 길러 왔다. 신진 창작자들의 국제적 공동체는 전문 교수진, 저명한 객원 실무자, 업계 파트너의 지도 아래 학생들이 자신의 가능성을 최대한 끌어내도록 돕는다. Guildhall 스쿨 교육의 질은 세계적으로 인정받아, 2026년 QS 세계대학평가에서 공연예술 부문 세계 3위 안, 음악 부문 세계 4위 안에 올랐다. 우리는 혁신과 실험을 지지하며 예술 실천의 경계를 넓히고 있고, 연구 영향력은 영국 음악원 가운데 가장 높은 세계적 수준으로 평가받는다. Guildhall School is where passion meets purpose. We deliver world-class professional training in music, drama, production and design, across our iconic state-of-the-art facilities in the heart of the City of London. For almost 150 years, we have shaped the craft and careers of countless talented performers and artists who have gone on to forge successful paths on stage, on screen and behind the scenes. Our international community of emerging creatives is guided by expert teaching staff, renowned visiting practitioners and industry partners, supporting students to unlock their highest potential. The quality of Guildhall School’s training is recognised globally, with our programmes ranked in the top three in the world for Performing Arts and the top four in the world for Music by the QS World University Rankings 2026. We push the boundaries of artistic practice, championing innovation and experimentation, and our research impact is recognised as world-leading – the highest of any UK music conservatoire.

title: Harry Pearce
tldr: 2006년부터 Pentagram 런던 사무소의 파트너인 영국 그래픽 디자이너
info: Harry Pearce는 그래픽 디자이너, 우연주의자(accidentalist), 영원한 낙천주의자, 사진가다. 캔터베리 예술대학에서 공부했다. 2006년 Pentagram의 파트너로 합류하기 전, 16년간 Lippa Pearce Design을 공동 설립·운영했다. Pearce는 Liberty, Thames & Hudson, Camden Art Centre, WITNESS, John Lewis Partnership, Waitrose & Partners No.1, 왕립예술원, 아부다비 문화지구, Berry Bros & Rudd, Phaidon Press, Pink Floyd Records, Saks Fifth Avenue, Lloyd’s of London, 셰익스피어 글로브, PEN International, 과학박물관, 유엔 등 다양한 클라이언트를 위해 전 세계에서 아이덴티티, 설치, 포스터, 패키지, 책, 강연을 고안해 왔다. Ai Weiwei와 Anish Kapoor의 왕립예술원 회고전 아이덴티티도 만들었다. 그의 작업은 뉴욕, 파리, 런던, 토론토, 나폴리에서 전시되었다. 1993년부터 Peter Gabriel이 설립한 인권 자선단체 WITNESS의 자문위원으로 활동해 왔다. 국제그래픽연맹(AGI)의 헌신적인 회원이기도 하며, 호주, 남아프리카공화국, 뉴질랜드, 미국, 인도, 네덜란드, 코스타리카 등 전 세계 디자인 콘퍼런스에서 강연했다. Pearce는 《Typographic Conundrums》(2009)와 《Eating with the Eyes》(2015) 두 권의 저자다. Harry Pearce is a graphic designer, accidentalist, eternal optimist and photographer. He studied at [Canterbury College of Art.](http://www.uca.ac.uk/) Before joining Pentagram as a partner in 2006, he co-founded and co-ran Lippa Pearce Design for 16 years. Pearce has worked around the world devising identities, installations, posters, packaging, books and talks for clients as diverse as Liberty, Thames & Hudson, Camden Art Centre, WITNESS, The John Lewis Partnership, Waitrose & Partners No.1, the Royal Academy of Arts, Abu Dhabi cultural quarter, Berry Bros & Rudd, Phaidon Press, Pink Floyd Records, Saks Fifth Avenue, Lloyd’s of London, Shakespeare’s Globe, PEN International, Science Museum and the UN. For Ai Weiwei and Anish Kapoor, he created identities for their major retrospectives at the RA. His work has been exhibited in New York, Paris, London, Toronto and Naples. Since 1993 he has been an active member of the advisory board for [WITNESS,](http://witness.org/) a human rights charity founded by Peter Gabriel. He is also a committed member of [Alliance Graphique Internationale](http://a-g-i.org/) and has spoken at design conferences across the globe including Australia, South Africa, New Zealand, USA, India, Holland and Costa Rica. Pearce is the author of two books, [_Typographic Conundrums_](http://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/0061826596) (published in 2009) and [_Eating with the Eyes_](https://uniteditions.com/) (published in 2015). Follow Harry on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/harrywpearce/).

> 1993년부터 Peter Gabriel이 설립한 인권 자선단체 WITNESS의 자문위원으로 활동해 왔다. 국제그래픽연맹(AGI)의 헌신적인 회원이기도 하며, 호주, 남아프리카공화국, 뉴질랜드, 미국, 인도, 네덜란드, 코스타리카 등 전 세계 디자인 콘퍼런스에서 강연했다.
>
> Pearce는 《Typographic Conundrums》(2009)와 《Eating with the Eyes》(2015) 두 권의 저자다.
>
> Harry Pearce is a graphic designer, accidentalist, eternal optimist and photographer.
>
> He studied at [Canterbury College of Art.](http://www.uca.ac.uk/) Before joining Pentagram as a partner in 2006, he co-founded and co-ran Lippa Pearce Design for 16 years.
>
> Pearce has worked around the world devising identities, installations, posters, packaging, books and talks for clients as diverse as Liberty, Thames & Hudson, Camden Art Centre, WITNESS, The John Lewis Partnership, Waitrose & Partners No.1, the Royal Academy of Arts, Abu Dhabi cultural quarter, Berry Bros & Rudd, Phaidon Press, Pink Floyd Records, Saks Fifth Avenue, Lloyd’s of London, Shakespeare’s Globe, PEN International, Science Museum and the UN. For Ai Weiwei and Anish Kapoor, he created identities for their major retrospectives at the RA.
>
> His work has been exhibited in New York, Paris, London, Toronto and Naples.
>
> Since 1993 he has been an active member of the advisory board for [WITNESS,](http://witness.org/) a human rights charity founded by Peter Gabriel. He is also a committed member of [Alliance Graphique Internationale](http://a-g-i.org/) and has spoken at design conferences across the globe including Australia, South Africa, New Zealand, USA, India, Holland and Costa Rica.
>
> Pearce is the author of two books, [_Typographic Conundrums_](http://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/0061826596) (published in 2009) and [_Eating with the Eyes_](https://uniteditions.com/) (published in 2015).

info: Haydonna가 설립한 아티스트 주도의 크리에이티브 스튜디오이자, 브랜드·공간·오브제·경험을 가로지르는 오리지널 작업과 협업으로 동시대 문화를 만드는 레이블 Where Art Shapes Presence. HAY TIN is an Artist-led Creative Label founded and directed by Haydonna. Through brands, spaces, objects, and experiences, TIN creates contemporary culture through original works and collaborations. Grounded in aesthetic judgment, of form and color, sensibility and style, we articulate the worlds that brands hold within them. ​ HAY TIN does not view design as a mere outcome of problem-solving. We begin with aesthetics. Guided by the artist’s discernment of form, color, sensibility, and style, we determine how a brand should exist, and translate that vision into a cohesive and consistent direction. ​ Across products, spaces, content, and experiences, our work begins with an exploration of material and color, proportion and rhythm, and a distinct visual attitude. Each project is completed as a style, as a scene of its own, where a brand acquires its unique atmosphere and presence. ​ Haydonna’s practice moves fluidly between form and graphic, artwork and space, designing brands to be perceived as fully realized worlds. Rather than repeating standardized design languages, we propose new aesthetics and new visual orders that brands have yet to reach. ​ Collaborating with HAY TIN is not about following conventional formulas. It is a process of shaping a brand’s next chapter through the artist’s vision, in ways that did not previously exist.

title: Hearing Things
info: Hearing Things is a new home for independent music journalism.
rawContent:
>[!tldr] tl;dr
>

> [!Info]
> Hearing Things is a new home for independent music journalism.

The music industry is once again at a crossroads. Streaming was supposed to democratize music, making it more equitable for all. That didn’t happen. Now the most famous artists are dominating the industry like never before, while everyone else is scrounging for pennies. What’s left of music media is chasing those same huge artists for an ever-decreasing slice of the SEO pie. Virality is king, stan armies run rampant, A.I. is ascendant. It can sometimes feel like the urge to make a meaningful connection with an artist, album, or song is almost passé.

> [!Summary]

---

## Members


[**Andy Cush**](https://www.hearingthings.co/author/andy-cush/) is a writer and musician who’s done time at Pitchfork, Spin, Gawker, and in the indie-psych-jam band Garcia Peoples. Beginning in 2020, he was a contributing editor at Pitchfork, where he wrote about the pandemic’s effects on working musicians, helped to shape the site’s investigative reporting, and occasionally edited the Sunday Review. His writing is informed by his dual perspectives as a musician and listener, seeking a middle path between the sometimes divergent ways that each side thinks and talks about the music they both love. If he could time-travel to any one concert, he’d head to the Fillmore West on April 10, 1970, to catch the double bill of Miles Davis and the Grateful Dead.

[**Ryan Dombal**](https://www.hearingthings.co/author/ryan-dombal/) established and spearheaded features coverage at Pitchfork during his 15 years on staff there. He edited, produced, and wrote multimedia cover stories, reviewed some of the most crucial albums of the century so far, and interviewed everyone from Erykah Badu to Randy Newman. He helped create the wonderfully dumb web series “Over/Under.” He’s constantly searching for new and exciting artists, and wrote early profiles on the likes of James Blake, Charli XCX, and Ethel Cain before they were famous. He would happily live inside D’Angelo’s album _Voodoo_ if given the chance.

[**Julianne Escobedo Shepherd**](https://www.hearingthings.co/author/julianne-escobedo-shepherd/) is a Xicana writer, editor, and author. She was formerly the top editor at both Jezebel and The Fader, and over the past 25 years has written for a slew of publications including Hell Gate, Vibe, Rookie, Spin, The Guardian, Flaming Hydra, Vogue, and Pitchfork, where she was a contributing writer. Her forthcoming book from Penguin, _Vaquera_, is about growing up Mexican American in Wyoming and the myth of the American West. Her go-to karaoke joint is Aaliyah’s “Are You That Somebody?” (which is deceptively hard to sing).

[**Dylan Green**](https://www.hearingthings.co/author/dylan-green/) is a journalist, critic, and podcast host who has written about hip-hop, film, and culture for publications ranging from DJBooth and Okayplayer to The Fader, Complex, and The Face. They are a former contributing writer at Pitchfork and the host of the Reel Notes podcast, and have interviewed artists both seasoned (Sean Paul, Lupe Fiasco, Large Professor) and fresh (Mike, Clip, BbyAfricka) in the decade they’ve been writing professionally. They’re probably in a Wawa mumbling a Gangsta Boo verse to themselves.

[**Jill Mapes**](https://www.hearingthings.co/author/jill-mapes/) is a culture writer and editor with past lives at Vulture, Billboard, Flavorwire (RIP), CBS, and The Indianapolis Star. She spent eight years on staff at Pitchfork, expanding the site’s blog, The Pitch, into a hub for short-form features; editing deep dives on everything from TikTok hits to queer nightlife to big ticketing; and penning reviews and profiles of personal favorites like Angel Olsen, Beach House, Mitski, Big Thief, and Caroline Polachek. The best thing that ever happened to her on assignment was getting unsolicited life advice from Cher (“Always wear black eyeliner and ‘do you’”); the worst thing was getting doxxed by Swifties after giving _folklore_ an 8.0.

title: Heatherwick Studio
tldr: 런던과 상하이에 작업장을 둔 영국 디자인·건축 스튜디오
info: 우리는 모든 사람을 위해 우리 주변의 물리적 세계를 더 낫게 만드는 데 전념하는 250명 이상의 문제 해결사 팀이다. 런던과 상하이에 있는 작업장 겸 디자인 스튜디오를 기반으로 건물, 공간, 오브제, 인프라를 만든다. 우리는 우리 주변의 건물과 장소가 훨씬 더 즐겁고, 매력적이고, 인간적인 세상을 보고 싶다. 건축가, 디자이너, 제작자, 엔지니어, 조경가로 이루어진 우리 팀은 현실 세계의 복잡성을 기리는 영혼 있고 임팩트 있는 장소를 디자인하려는 동기를 공유한다. 모든 것을 이끄는 접근은 고정된 디자인 신념이 아니라 인간의 경험에서 출발하는 것이다. We are a team of over 250 problem solvers dedicated to making the physical world around us better for everyone. Based out of our combined workshop and design studios in London and Shanghai, we create buildings, spaces, objects and infrastructure. We want to see a world where the buildings and places around us are radically more joyful, engaging and human. Our team of architects, designers, makers, engineers and landscape architects share a motivation to design soulful and impactful places, which celebrate the complexities of the real world. > [!Info]
> 우리는 모든 사람을 위해 우리 주변의 물리적 세계를 더 낫게 만드는 데 전념하는 250명 이상의 문제 해결사 팀이다.
>
> 런던과 상하이에 있는 작업장 겸 디자인 스튜디오를 기반으로 건물, 공간, 오브제, 인프라를 만든다.
>
> 우리는 우리 주변의 건물과 장소가 훨씬 더 즐겁고, 매력적이고, 인간적인 세상을 보고 싶다.
>
> 건축가, 디자이너, 제작자, 엔지니어, 조경가로 이루어진 우리 팀은 현실 세계의 복잡성을 기리는 영혼 있고 임팩트 있는 장소를 디자인하려는 동기를 공유한다. 모든 것을 이끄는 접근은 고정된 디자인 신념이 아니라 인간의 경험에서 출발하는 것이다.
>
> We are a team of over 250 problem solvers dedicated to making the physical world around us better for everyone.
>
> Based out of our combined workshop and design studios in London and Shanghai, we create buildings, spaces, objects and infrastructure.
>
> We want to see a world where the buildings and places around us are radically more joyful, engaging and human.
>
> Our team of architects, designers, makers, engineers and landscape architects share a motivation to design soulful and impactful places, which celebrate the complexities of the real world. The approach driving everything is to lead from human experience rather than any fixed design belief.

title: Heesun Kim
tldr: Studio fnt의 공동 대표이자 크리에이티브 디렉터
info: 김희선은 카이스트(KAIST)에서 산업디자인을 공부했습니다. 2001년부터 기업 브랜딩과 커뮤니케이션 부문에서 다양한 프로젝트 경험을 쌓았습니다. 2011년 스튜디오 fnt에 크리에이티브 디렉터로 합류하여 프로젝트의 디자인 전략을 수립하고 구체화하는 역할을 맡고 있습니다. 대한민국 관광 공모전, 한국전통문화대학교 상품 개발 프로젝트, 한국공예·디자인문화진흥원 전통 문화유산 활용 브랜드 공모, 국립중앙박물관 공모상품 등에 자문 및 심사위원으로 참여하고 있습니다. After studying industrial design at KAIST, Heesun Kim has conducted various local and international projects since 2001, spanning corporate branding, promotion, and events. Since 2011, she has worked as creative director at Studio fnt, directing design strategies and leading key projects. She has served as an advisor and judge for numerous public and cultural initiatives, including the Korea Tourism Competition, the Korea National University of Cultural Heritage Product Development Project, the KCDF Traditional Cultural Heritage Brand Competition, and the National Museum of Korea Product Competition.

info: HENN은 수십 년의 디자인 경험으로 선구적인 업무 환경을 만든다. 우리는 미래를 만들어 가는 사람과 조직에 힘을 주는 공간을 디자인한다. 생태적·사회적으로 지속가능한 미래에 대한 우리의 헌신은 건축이 변화의 능동적 주체이자 혁신의 동력이 될 수 있다는 믿음에서 나온다. HENN은 사무, 과학, 의료, 산업, 문화 분야에서 75년 이상의 전문성을 지닌 국제 건축 사무소다. 수십 년의 건축 경험에서 얻은 풍부한 지식과 전 세계 파트너·전문가 네트워크를 활용할 수 있는 건축가와 엔지니어의 학제적 팀이다. HENN draws on decades of design experience to create visionary work environments. We design spaces to empower people and organizations shaping our future. Our commitment to an ecologically and socially sustainable future is guided by the belief that architecture can be an active agent of change and a driver of innovation. HENN is an international architecture practice with more than 75 years of expertise in the fields of office, science, health, industry and culture. We are an interdisciplinary team of architects and engineers able to draw upon a wealth of knowledge collected over decades of building experience in addition to a worldwide network of partners and experts.

Hermès International S.C.A., using the trade name Hermès Paris or simply Hermès, is a French luxury goods company that was founded in 1837 by Thierry Hermès in Paris, France. At that time, it specialized in the saddlery and harness making trade, producing equipment for horse riders and their horses. The company then branched out into trades including leather goods, followed by silk, ready-to-wear, watchmaking, jewellery, fashion accessories and perfumery. In 2020, the beauty division added a sixteenth business line.

tldr: Pentagram 런던 사무소의 파트너, 그래픽 디자이너·아트 디렉터
info: Hugh Miller는 그래픽 디자이너이자 아트 디렉터이며 Pentagram 런던 사무소의 파트너다. 국제 디자인 스튜디오 BOND의 런던 사무소를 공동 설립했고 브랜딩과 비주얼 아이덴티티에서 폭넓은 경험이 있다. 이름난 스튜디오 SPIN에서는 Whitechapel 아이덴티티와 Nike, MTV 등 클라이언트의 캠페인 작업을 했다. 이후 Nokia와 Microsoft 두 회사의 브랜드 팀에 파견되었고, 가장 최근에는 Ford의 연구 중심 혁신 부서 Human-Centred Design에 상주했다. Hugh의 작업은 D&AD, Type Directors Club, 국제타이포그래픽디자이너협회(ISTD)에서 인정받았다. 디자인 아카이브 애호가이자 타이포그래피 옹호자로서 킹스턴 예술대학과 그리니치대학교에서 강연했으며 현재 ISTD 이사로 활동한다. SO/LO의 《At the End of the World, Plant a Tree》 레코드 슬리브 디자인으로 ISTD의 최고 영예인 첫 Freda Sack Award를 받았다. 최근 《Creative Boom》이 선정한 2025년 ‘가장 영감을 주는 그래픽 디자이너 20인’에 이름을 올렸다. Hugh Miller is a graphic designer, art director and Partner at Pentagram’s London office. Co-founder of the London office of the international design studio BOND, Hugh has extensive experience in branding and visual identity. While at renowned studio SPIN he worked on projects such as the Whitechapel identity and for campaigns for clients including Nike and MTV. He was later embedded into the brand teams of both Nokia and Microsoft, and most recently was based within Ford’s research-focused innovation unit, Human-Centred Design. Hugh’s work has earned recognition from D&AD, the Type Directors Club and the International Society of Typographic Designers (ISTD). A design archive enthusiast and typography advocate, he has lectured at Kingston School of Art and the University of Greenwich, and currently serves on the board of the ISTD. His record sleeve design for SO/LO’s _At the End of the World, Plant a Tree_ received the inaugural Freda Sack Award, which is the ISTD‘s highest honour. Hugh was recently named as one of Creative Boom’s ‘20 Most Inspiring Graphic Designers’ in 2025. Follow Hugh on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/neue_miller/) and [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hugh-miller-ba19104/)

title: HYBE UMG
tldr: HYBE와 유니버설 뮤직 그룹 게펜 레코드의 합작 투자 파트너십
info: 2021년 2월, HYBE와 유니버설 뮤직 그룹(UMG)의 게펜 레코드(Geffen Records)가 전략적 합작투자 파트너십을 공식 발표했습니다. 세계적 위상을 자랑하는 K-POP 트레이닝 및 육성 시스템을 기반으로 최초의 미국 기반 글로벌 걸그룹을 만들기 위해 미국의 주요 음반 레이블과 대표적인 K-POP 및 엔터테인먼트 라이프스타일 플랫폼 기업 간에 전례 없는 협업이 이루어 졌습니다. 미국 음반 레이블과 K-팝 엔터테인먼트 기업이 아티스트 발굴, 육성 및 음악 제작에 대한 전문 지식을 결합해 그룹을 구성하여 선보이는 최초의 사례입니다. 소속 아티스트로는 글로벌 오디션 쇼 ‘더 데뷔: 드림아카데미’를 통해 2024년 6월에 데뷔한 캣츠아이(KATSEYE)가 있습니다. HYBE 공식 홈페이지 소개문 HYBE와 유니버설 뮤직 그룹의 합작 설립 회사이며, 지분 51%를 보유한 HYBE의 자회사다.

title: i-D
tldr: 1980년 Terry Jones가 런던에서 창간한 패션·유스 컬처 매거진
info: 1980년 펑크 시대의 런던에서 시작한 이래 i-D는 반항적인 펑크 정신과 신진 재능을 북돋우려는 열정으로 움직여 왔다. 타자기로 친 진(zine)으로 출발해 오늘날 선도적 비전가들의 경력을 열어 주기까지, 우리는 스타일과 창의성을 둘러싼 대화를 꾸준히 이끌어 왔다. 문화를 앞으로 이끄는 비전가들에 대한 비길 데 없는 접근, 언더그라운드 신에 대한 날카로운 보도, 소음을 뚫고 나아가는 역동적인 편집 비전으로 i-D는 계속해서 문화적 시대정신의 중심에 있다. 우리는 혁신적인 독립 미디어가 그 어느 때보다 중요하다고 믿으며, 온라인과 지면에서 우리가 보여 주는 방식으로 그것을 증명하고자 한다. Since the punk-era London of 1980, i-D has been powered by a rebel punk spirit and passion for uplifting emerging talent. From our beginnings as a typewritten zine to launching the careers of today’s leading visionaries, we have consistently shaped the conversation around style and creativity. With unrivalled access to the visionaries pushing culture forward, sharp coverage of underground scenes, and a dynamic editorial vision that cuts through the noise, i-D continues to be at the centre of the cultural zeitgeist. We believe that innovative independent media matters more than ever, and we’re committed to proving it with how we show up online and in print.

title: Illustration (College for Creative Studies)
tldr: `Bachelor's Program` in illustration of College for Creative Studies
info: 일러스트레이션 학과는 기본기와 기술적 역량을 나만의 아이디어와 결합하도록 장려해, 여러 창작 산업 전반의 일에 대비하게 합니다. 일러스트레이션 선택 과목은 비주얼 디벨롭먼트, 출판, 패션 라이프스타일·라이선싱, 만화·순차 예술, 갤러리 아티스트의 길로 이어지는 경로를 이룹니다. 이 경로들을 통해 자신의 커리어 목표와 창작 관심사에 맞는 포트폴리오를 개발하게 됩니다. The Illustration department encourages the combination of fundamentals and technical skills with your original ideas, to prepare you for work across multiple creative industries. The illustration elective course options form pathways in Visual Development, Publishing, Fashion Lifestyle and Licensing, Comics and Sequential, or Gallery Artist. Through these pathways, you will develop a portfolio specific to your career goals and creative interests.

title: Illustration (The Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT))
tldr: `Bachelor's Program` in illustration of The Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT)
info: FIT의 일러스트레이션은 시각 커뮤니케이션, 곧 예술로 아이디어와 감정을 표현하는 이야기를 하는 일이다. 영감을 받은 예술가인 학생들은 첫 수업부터 드로잉, 회화, 개념적 역량을 최첨단 기술의 힘과 통합해 이미지를 만들기 시작한다. 이 프로그램에서는 아이디어를 내고, 조사로 지식을 쌓고, 어느 분야에서나 적용할 수 있는 문제 해결 능력을 기른다. 고급 기술을 갖추고 나만의 일러스트레이션 스타일을 확립하면서 수요가 높은 전문가 수준의 작품을 만든다. 해마다 열리는 눈에 띄는 야외 벽화 프로젝트 ChalkFIT는 학생들이 작품을 대중에게 선보이게 한다. Illustration at FIT is about visual communication — using art to tell stories that express ideas and emotions. Our students are inspired artists who, from their very first class, begin to integrate drawing, painting, and conceptual abilities with the power of cutting-edge technology to create images. In this program, you’ll learn how to generate ideas, build knowledge through research, and develop problem-solving skills that can be applied in any area. You’ll develop advanced skills and establish your unique illustrative style while producing professional-quality work that is in demand. Every year, a high-profile outdoor mural project, ChalkFIT, enables students to showcase their work to the public.

info: 개인 연구 프로젝트가 프로그램의 중심이다. 마음을 움직이는 주제를 골라 시각적으로도 내용적으로도 발전시킨다. 이와 함께 서사의 힘, 기술적 역량, 연구 지향적 태도를 키우는 모듈을 수강한다. A personal research project forms the heart of the programme. title: Illustration, BFA (RISD)
tldr: `Bachelor's Program` in illustration of RISD
info: 4년제 일러스트레이션 BFA 프로그램에서는 대체로 자기 주도적으로 매체를 탐구하며 동시대의 주제와 개념을 확실히 이해하게 된다. 교수진은 예리한 관찰, 강한 개념적 사고, 아이디어를 설득력 있게 전달하는 데 필요한 손기술과 기법의 숙달을 격려한다. 첫해인 2학년생은 창의적 지성과 기술적 능숙함을 모두 키우는 데 집중한다. 일러스트레이션 문제 해결 과목은 독창적 사고와 개념의 명확함을 길러 주고, 드로잉과 회화 수업은 이미지 제작의 기본 기술을 강화한다. In the four-year Illustration BFA program you take on a largely self-directed exploration of media, gaining a solid understanding of contemporary themes and concepts. Faculty encourage keen observation, strong conceptual thinking, and the mastery of manual skills and techniques you need to convey ideas in a compelling manner. In the first year, sophomores focus on developing both creative intelligence and technical facility. Courses in illustrative problem solving nurture original thinking and conceptual clarity, while classes in drawing and painting strengthen basic image-making skills.

info: 지난 75년 동안 SVA의 BFA 일러스트레이션 졸업생들은 인쇄, 웹, 스크린을 통해 우리가 세계를 경험하는 방식을 이미지로 만들고, 이야기하고, 비판적으로 생각하고, 구성하며 이미지 제작의 경계에 도전해 왔다. 가장 존경받는 잡지와 신문부터 실험적인 온라인 애플리케이션, 수상작 애니메이션, 블록버스터 영화, 머천다이징, 벽화에 이르기까지 모두가 일러스트레이션이다. 3학년의 픽토리얼 프로젝트(Pictorial Projects)와 시니어 논문(Senior Thesis) 같은 핵심 과목, 그리고 폭넓은 관련 선택 과목을 중심으로 하는 역동적인 교육 계획을 바탕으로, 학생들은 이미지 제작에 대한 열정을 이를 받아들일 산업과 연결하며 효과적인 작품군을 쌓는다. For the last 75 years, SVA’s BFA Illustration graduates have challenged the boundaries of image making, storytelling, critical thinking, and composing the ways we experience our world through print, web, and screen. From the most respected magazines and newspapers of record to experimental online applications, award-winning animation, blockbuster movies, merchandising, or murals—it’s all illustration. Based on a dynamic teaching plan that revolves around core courses, such as Pictorial Projects for third-year students and the Senior Thesis, as well as an extensive suite of relevant electives, our students develop effective bodies of work, connecting their passion for image making to industries that will embrace them.

title: Ilya Sutskever
tldr: 딥러닝에 기여한 OpenAI 공동 창업자 출신의 컴퓨터 과학자
info: Ilya Sutskever(히브리어: איליה סוצקבר, 1986년생)는 소련 출생의 이스라엘·캐나다 컴퓨터 과학자로 머신러닝을 전문으로 한다. 시퀀스 투 시퀀스 학습, 추론 모델, GPT 모델, CLIP, DALL-E, AlphaGo 등 딥러닝 분야에 여러 핵심 기여를 했다. Alex Krizhevsky, Geoffrey Hinton과 함께 합성곱 신경망 AlexNet을 공동 개발했다. OpenAI를 공동 창업해 수석 과학자로 대규모 언어 모델과 ChatGPT 출시로 이어진 연구를 총괄했고, o1 같은 추론 모델로 이어진 연구도 이끌었다. 2023년 Sam Altman을 CEO에서 해임한 OpenAI 이사회 구성원 가운데 한 명이었고, Altman이 일주일 뒤 복귀한 뒤 이사회에서 물러났다. Ilya Sutskever (Hebrew: איליה סוצקבר; born 1986) is a Soviet-born Israeli-Canadian computer scientist who specializes in machine learning. He has made several major contributions to the field of deep learning, including sequence-to-sequence learning, reasoning models, GPT models, and contributions to CLIP, DALL-E, and AlphaGo. With Alex Krizhevsky and Geoffrey Hinton, he co-created AlexNet, a convolutional neural network. One of the most highly cited computer scientists in history, he has won the NeurIPS Test of Time Award for his lasting impact on AI research three times in a row (2022–2024) and received the National Academy of Sciences Award for the Industrial Application of Science in 2026. Sutskever co-founded OpenAI, where he served as chief scientist, overseeing the research breakthroughs that led to large language models and the launch of ChatGPT. He also led the research that led to reasoning models such as o1. In 2023, he was one of the members of OpenAI's board that ousted Sam Altman as its CEO; Altman was reinstated a week later, and Sutskever stepped down from the board. In June 2024, Sutskever co-founded the company Safe Superintelligence Inc., alongside Daniel Gross and Daniel Levy. Within a year, the company was valued at more than $30 billion.

title: Imruh Asha
tldr: `Fashion Director` at DAZED
info: Imruh Asha는 파리를 기반으로 하는 스타일리스트, 크리에이티브 컨설턴트, 패션 디렉터로, 독특한 스토리텔링 방식으로 보는 이에게 패션 너머를 보게 한다. 네덜란드-카리브 뿌리와 현대미술의 특징에서 끌어온 관점으로, 개념 중심이면서 깊이 직관적인 다면적 이미지 제작 방식을 다듬어 왔다. 기대의 경계에서 끊임없이 작업하는 혁신가로서의 명성으로 2022년 《Dazed & Confused》 패션 디렉터에 임명되었으며 2021년부터 팀의 일원이었다. 그곳에서 공식 기네스 세계 기록 세 개를 깨는 것부터 히말라야 마을에서 여섯 살 사진가와 촬영하는 것까지, 패션 이미지를 짜릿한 새로운 곳으로 밀어붙였다. 2021년에는 도버 스트리트 마켓 3537 공간에서 Ere Foundation과 함께 조각 전시 《Future Shock》로 첫 전시를 열었다. 개인 프로젝트부터 시즌 쇼와 캠페인까지, 조용하고도 대담한 순간들은 예술 분야를 가로지르는 협업의 힘이라는 정신을 공유한다. “관습적으로 기대되는 것에 도전하는 일입니다.” 그가 존경하는 아티스트들을 패션 맥락으로 데려오는 것에 대해 한 말이다. “늘 아름다운 작업을 만들어 왔고 지금도 만들고 있는 위대한 아티스트들에게서 정말 영감을 받습니다.” 신진 재능과 더 자리 잡은 이름 모두와 일하는 취향을 보여 주듯, Asha의 협업자는 Carlijn Jacobs, Viviane Sassen, Paul Kooiker, Paolo Roversi, Rafael Pavarotti, Osma Harvilahti, Oliver Hadlee Pearch, Gabriel Moses, Jacobs+Talbourdet-Napoleone, Harley Weir, Martin Parr, Dan Tobin Smith, Mark Kean 등이다. 그의 작업은 《Dazed》, 미국판 《Vogue》, 《Vogue Italia》, 《M Le Monde》, 《Self Service》, 《AnOther》, 《W》 등에 실렸고, 클라이언트로는 Hermès, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, Dior, Off-White, Botter, Jacquemus, Pucci, Moschino, Moncler, Kiko Kostadinov, Calvin Klein 등이 있다. Imruh Asha is a Paris-based stylist, creative consultant, and fashion director whose distinct mode of storytelling asks the viewer to look beyond fashion. With a point-of-view that draws from his Dutch-Caribbean roots as well as the signatures of contemporary art, Asha has refined a prismatic approach to image making that is both concept-driven and deeply intuitive. Constantly working at the boundaries of the expected, Asha’s reputation for innovation led to his 2022 appointment as Fashion Director of Dazed & Confused, where he has been a member of the team since 2021. There, he has pushed fashion imagery to thrilling new places, from breaking three official Guinness world records, to shooting with a six-year-old photographer in a Himalayan village. Also in 2021, Asha debuted his first exhibition with Future Shock, a sculpture show in conjunction with the Ere Foundation in Dover Street Market’s 3537 space. From such personal projects, to seasonal shows and campaigns, Asha’s quiet and bold moments alike share a certain spirit in common: that of the power of collaboration across artistic disciplines. “It’s about challenging what’s conventionally expected”, he says of bringing artists he admires into fashion contexts. “I’m really inspired by those great artists that have always made, and continue to make, beautiful work.” Showcasing his taste for working with rising talents as well as more established names, Asha’s collaborators have included Carlijn Jacobs, Viviane Sassen, Paul Kooiker, Paolo Roversi, Rafael Pavarotti, Osma Harvilahti, Oliver Hadlee Pearch, Gabriel Moses, Jacobs+Talbourdet-Napoleone, Harley Weir, Martin Parr, Dan Tobin Smith, and Mark Kean. His work has appeared in magazines including Dazed, American Vogue, Vogue Italia, M Le Monde, Self Service, AnOther, and W, and his clients have included Hermès, Louis Vuitton, Gucci, Dior, Off-White, Botter, Jacquemus, Pucci, Moschino, Moncler, Kiko Kostadinov, and Calvin Klein, among others.

title: Industrial Design, BID (Pratt Institute)
tldr: `Bachelor's Program` in Industrial Design of Pratt Institute
info: 21세기의 전문 디자이너가 되어 오늘날의 거대한 과제에 맞서세요. 업계 전문가로든 기업가로든, 삶을 혁신하고 개선하는 디자인 해법과 전략을 개발하게 됩니다. Pratt 산업디자인 학생은 디자이너, 예술가, 교육자, 기업가, 연구자, 기업 리더가 됩니다. 드로잉, 색, 3차원 형태, 모델 제작, 디지털 컴퓨터 기술의 기초 과목과 비판적 사고·문제 해결·환경적 책임을 소개하는 디자인 스튜디오로 시작해, 3·4학년에는 제품 디자인, 가구, 테이블웨어, 푸드 디자인, 스포츠 장비, 전시 디자인 등 개인의 관심 분야에 맞춘 특화 스튜디오를 듣습니다. Become a professional designer for the 21st century, ready to tackle current momentous challenges. Whether as an industry professional or an entrepreneur, you’ll develop design solutions and strategies that innovate and improve life. Pratt Industrial Design students become designers, artists, educators, entrepreneurs, researchers, and corporate leaders — diversity fostered by a program that encourages exploration and professional growth. You’ll begin with grounding courses in drawing, color, 3-D form, model making, and digital computer skills, and design studios that introduce you to critical thinking, problem solving, and environmental responsibility. During junior and senior year, specialized studios focus on your individual areas of interest such as product design, furniture, tabletop, food design, athletic gear, or exhibition design.

info: 산업 디자이너는 길고 다양한 학습 과정을 거친다. 그들의 작업 방식은 초기 가정의 범위를 넓힐 수 있게 해 주지만 항상 실용적인 해법으로 이어진다. 그들의 직업적 실천은 종종 컨설팅과 비슷하다. 하지만 실제로 그들의 기여는 그보다 더 나아가 아이디어에 구체적인 형태를 부여한다. 산업 디자이너는 탐구심, 직관, 상상력, 경청하는 능력, 스스로를 되돌아보는 감수성, 분석 재능, 전체를 조망하는 능력 등 특별한 개인적 자질을 지닌다. 그들은 본성과 역량상 프로젝트가 발전하는 동안 늘 검토하고 재고하며, 더 높은 수준의 기술적·마케팅 성과를 낼 새로운 해법을 구상하려 애쓴다. Industrial designers follow a long and diverse programme of learning. Although their working method makes it possible to broaden the scope of initial assumptions, it always results in a practical solution. Their professional practice is often similar to consultancy. But in reality, their contribution goes further than that, because they give tangible expression to ideas. Industrial designers have particular personal qualities, including an enquiring mind, intuition, imagination, good listening skills, sensitivity, the ability to question themselves, a talent for analysis and the ability to form an overview. By their nature and skills, they always strive to review and reconsider projects as they develop, and to envision new solutions to deliver higher levels of technical and marketing performance.

title: Ingeborg Erhart
tldr: `Vice-Rector for Art and Teaching` of Academy of Fine Arts Vienna
info: 잉에보르크 에르하르트는 1971년 인스브루크에서 태어나 인스브루크와 빈에서 미술사를 공부했다. 박사논문은 『Vanishing Voids. Motive des Verschwindens in der zeitgenössischen Kunst』(사라지는 공백: 동시대 미술 속 사라짐의 모티프)를 다루었다. 2001년부터 2019년까지 예술가 단체 티롤 예술가협회(Tiroler Künstler*schaft)의 예술감독이자 운영자였고, 큐레이터와 저술가로도 활동했다. 여러 자문위원회와 심사위원을 맡았는데, 2006년까지 티롤 현대미술·건축 문화자문위원회 위원, 2010년까지 티롤 지역 미술을 위한 오스트리아 연방총리실의 지원 구입 심사위원, 오스트리아 연방 교육·예술·문화부의 지원 구입 심사위원이었다. 2013년부터 2019년까지 인스브루크대학교 건축이론연구소의 시간강사로 가르쳤으며, 마지막 강의는 2018/2019년 겨울학기의 큐레이터 실천이었다. 2008년부터 2019년까지 티롤 공공공간 미술(Kunst im öffentlichen Raum Tirol)을 책임졌고, 인스브루크의 미술·건축 학교 빌딩(bilding)의 이사회 위원이기도 했다. Ingeborg Erhart, born in Innsbruck in 1971, studied art history in Innsbruck and Vienna. Her doctoral thesis dealt with the subject Vanishing Voids. Motive des Verschwindens in der zeitgenössischen Kunst (Motifs of Disappearance in Contemporary Art). She was artistic director and manager of the association of artists Tiroler Künstler*schaft from 2001 to 2019; worked as curator and author; She served on various advisory boards and juries: she was a member of the Tyrolean cultural advisory board for contemporary art and architecture until 2006, juror for supportive acquisitions on behalf of the Federal Chancellery of the Republic of Austria for art in Tyrol until 2010, and juror for supportive acquisitions on behalf of the Austrian Federal Ministry for Education, Arts and Culture until 2010. She taught as a part-time lecturer at the Institute of Architectural Theory of Innsbruck University from 2013 to 2019, most recently on curatorial practices in the winter term 2018/2019. From 2008 to 2019, Ingeborg Erhart was responsible for Kunst im öffentlichen Raum Tirol (Art in Public Space Tyrol). She was a board member of the art and architecture school bilding in Innsbruck.

title: Intermedia Art (Tokyo University of the Arts)
tldr: `Bachelor's Program` in intermedia art of Tokyo University of the Arts
info: 인터미디어아트과는 기존의 기법과 매체에 얽매이지 않는 개념화 능력을 바탕으로 자기만의 방식으로 자신의 비전을 표현할 수 있는 새로운 유형의 예술가가 성장하는 환경을 제공한다. 사회 전반에 열린 관점을 가지고 유연하고 적극적으로 접근하며, 다양한 생각과 감수성을 지닌 사람들과 자유롭게 소통할 수 있는 학생을 길러 내는 것이 목표다. 이 학과는 1999년, 대학의 기존 학과들이 단편적으로만 다루던 새로운 표현 영역을 다루고, 새로운 표현 매체를 찾아내며, 다가올 시대에 대한 인식이 담긴 작품을 장려하기 위해 설립되었다. 학생들은 시각·컴퓨터 매체를 사용한 표현에 그치지 않고, 퍼포먼스 아트 등 신체 표현의 여러 형식과 공간 자체를 표현 매체로 삼는 설치까지 폭넓게 공부할 수 있는 큰 자유를 누린다. The Department of Intermedia Art provides an environment that nurtures the development of a new breed of artists capable of expressing their own visions in their own ways, based on conceptualization skills unbound by preexisting techniques and media. Its goal is to develop students who have points of view that are open to society at large and take flexible and active approaches and who are able to communicate freely with individuals with diverse ideas and different sensibilities. This department was established in 1999 to address new expressive domains previously covered only in fragmented ways by the university’s existing departments, to seek out and identify new expressive media, and to encourage works imbued with an awareness of the coming times. Students in the department are permitted significant latitude to study not just expression using visual and computer media, but beyond, encompassing performance art and other forms of physical expression, as well as installations that turn space itself into an expressive medium.

title: Istituto Marangoni
tldr: `Art School` based in Milan
info: Istituto Marangoni는 90년이 넘도록 신진 인재를 길러 오며 학생들이 자신의 기량과 강점을 키우고 다듬도록 도왔다. 패션을 가르칠 수 있을까? 줄리오 마란고니는 1935년에 스스로 이렇게 물었다. 그는 이미 패션 의상으로 이탈리아 귀족 사회에서 명성을 얻은 뒤였다. 이에 답하기 위해 그는 밀라노에 마란고니 의류 예술 학교(Istituto Artistico dell’Abbigliamento Marangoni)를 세웠다. 패션 디자이너와 전문가를 위한 학교였다. Istituto Marangoni has nurtured emerging talent for over 90 years, helping students develop and hone their skills and strengths. is it possible to teach fashion? Giulio Marangoni asked himself this question back in 1935: his fame with the Italian aristocracy had already been established, thanks to his fashion garments. To answer it, he founded the Istituto Artistico dell’Abbigliamento Marangoni, or the Marangoni Artistic Clothing Institute in Milano. It was a school for fashion designers and professionals.

> 패션을 가르칠 수 있을까? 줄리오 마란고니는 1935년에 스스로 이렇게 물었다. 그는 이미 패션 의상으로 이탈리아 귀족 사회에서 명성을 얻은 뒤였다. 이에 답하기 위해 그는 밀라노에 마란고니 의류 예술 학교(Istituto Artistico dell’Abbigliamento Marangoni)를 세웠다. 패션 디자이너와 전문가를 위한 학교였다.
>
> Istituto Marangoni has nurtured emerging talent for over 90 years, helping students develop and hone their skills and strengths.
>
> is it possible to teach fashion? Giulio Marangoni asked himself this question back in 1935: his fame with the Italian aristocracy had already been established, thanks to his fashion garments. To answer it, he founded the Istituto Artistico dell’Abbigliamento Marangoni, or the Marangoni Artistic Clothing Institute in Milano. It was a school for fashion designers and professionals.

title: Jaemin Lee
tldr: Studio fnt의 공동 대표, 아트 디렉터 겸 그래픽 디자이너
info: 이재민은 서울대학교에서 시각디자인을 공부했습니다. 2006년 스튜디오 fnt를 설립한 이후, 그래픽 디자이너이자 아트 디렉터로서 프로젝트의 시각적 방향을 총괄해 왔습니다. 총감독을 맡아 [타이포잔치 2021: 국제 타이포그래피 비엔날레 《거북이와 두루미》](https://www.leejaemin.net/writing/typojanchi-2021-a-turtle-and-a-crane/)(서울, 2021)를 기획했고 [《코리아: 디자인 + 포스터》](http://dnstdm.de/en/korea-design-plakat/)(뮌헨, 2017), [《코리아 나우! 한국의 공예, 디자인, 패션, 그래픽 디자인》](https://madparis.fr/korea-now-craft-design-fashion-and-graphic-design-in-korea)(파리, 2015) 등의 전시에 참여했습니다. 서울시립대학교에서 시각디자인을 가르치고 있으며, 2016년부터 국제그래픽연맹(AGI) 회원으로 활동 중입니다. Jaemin Lee studied visual communication design at Seoul National University and founded Studio fnt in 2006. As a graphic designer and art director, he directs the visual language of diverse projects across the studio. He served as the director of Typojanchi 2021: International Typography Biennale — A Turtle and a Crane (Seoul, 2021) and has participated in exhibitions Korea: Design + Poster (Munich, 2017) and Korea Now! Craft, Design, Fashion, and Graphic Design in Korea (Paris, 2015). He teaches design at the University of Seoul and has been a member of the Alliance Graphique Internationale (AGI) since 2016.

title: James Williams
tldr: `Director` of Royal College of Music
info: 제임스 윌리엄스는 2024년 9월부터 왕립음악대학의 총장(Director)을 맡고 있다. 그 전에는 8년 동안 로열 필하모닉 오케스트라(RPO)의 상무이사(Managing Director)로서 바실리 페트렌코를 음악감독으로 임명하고, RPO가 로열 앨버트 홀의 협력 오케스트라(Associate Orchestra) 지위를 얻도록 했으며, 미국·유럽·아시아 주요 투어를 포함한 RPO의 국제적 입지를 넓혔다. 2023년 5월에는 찰스 3세 국왕의 요청으로 웨스트민스터 사원에서 열린 국왕 부부의 대관식 음악을 총괄했다. 필하모니아 오케스트라에서도 일하며 에사페카 살로넨, 로린 마젤, 랑랑, 블라디미르 아슈케나지 같은 예술가들과 오랜 협력 관계를 쌓았다. 음악 교육과 젊은 음악가의 경력 개발은 늘 그의 경력의 중심이었고, 왕립 노던 음악대학, 예후디 메뉴인의 라이브 뮤직 나우(Live Music Now) 프로그램, 메이필드 밸리 아트 트러스트의 이사(Trustee) 등의 직책을 거쳤다. James Williams has been Director of the Royal College of Music since September 2024. Prior to this, James spent eight years as Managing Director of the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra (RPO) during which time he appointed Vasily Petrenko as Music Director, secured Associate Orchestra status for the RPO at the Royal Albert Hall and developed the RPO’s international profile that included major tours to the USA, Europe and Asia. In May 2023, James was invited by His Majesty King Charles III to oversee the music for the Coronation Service of Their Majesties The King and Queen held at Westminster Abbey. James has also worked for the Philharmonia Orchestra building long-standing partnerships with artists such as Esa-Pekka Salonen, Lorin Maazel, Lang Lang and Vladimir Ashkenazy. Music education and developing the careers of young musicians has always played a central role in James’ career which has included positions at the Royal Northern College of Music, Yehudi Menuhin's Live Music Now scheme and as a Trustee of the Mayfield Valley Arts Trust.

> Jamila Robinson is the Editor-in-Chief of Bon Appétit and Epicurious. Robinson has twenty years of journalism experience with national news outlets including Gannett/USA Today Network, The Atlanta Journal-Constitution, the St. Louis Post-Dispatch and the Detroit Free Press.

In her most recent role at The Philadelphia Inquirer, Robinson led a team of reporters and expanded the publication's food coverage by creating audience-focused content strategies, growing their newsletter program, and revamping the print strategy. She also edited The Philadelphia Inquirer’s Emmy-winning “Wildest Dreams: An Anthology of Black Inheritance,” a multi-part series told through reporting, essays, poetry and video. 

Prior to The Philadelphia Inquirer, Robinson served as editorial director at Atlantic Media where she developed strategic editorial, brand and experiential content for clients of the creative consulting division of The Atlantic.

title: Jean Nouvel
tldr: 아랍세계연구소를 설계하고 2008년 프리츠커상을 받은 프랑스 건축가
info: Jean Nouvel(1945년 8월 12일생)은 프랑스의 건축가다. 파리 에콜 데 보자르에서 공부했고, 프랑스 최초의 건축가 노동조합인 Mars 1976과 Syndicat de l'Architecture의 창립 멤버였다. 자신이 설계한 아랍세계연구소로 아가 칸 건축상을 받은 것을 비롯해 2005년 울프상 예술 부문, 2008년 프리츠커상 등 권위 있는 상을 받았다. 여러 박물관과 건축 센터에서 그의 회고전이 열렸다. Jean Nouvel (French: [ʒɑ̃ nuvɛl]; born 12 August 1945) is a French architect. Nouvel studied at the École des Beaux-Arts in Paris and was a founding member of Mars 1976 and Syndicat de l'Architecture, France’s first labor union for architects. He has obtained a number of prestigious distinctions over the course of his career, including the Aga Khan Award for Architecture (for the Institut du Monde Arabe which Nouvel designed), the Wolf Prize in Arts in 2005 and the Pritzker Prize in 2008. A number of museums and architectural centres have presented retrospectives of his work.

info: Jefferson Hack은 영국의 큐레이터이자 크리에이티브 디렉터다. 인쇄, 디지털, 영상 브랜드 전반에 콘텐츠를 만드는 독립 미디어 회사 Dazed Media의 공동 창립자이자 편집 디렉터, CEO다. 이 회사의 포트폴리오에는 패션 연 2회 간행물 Another Magazine과 Another Man, 계간 유스 패션·문화 매거진 Dazed, 그리고 크리에이티브 부문 Dazed Studio가 있다. 이 매체들의 에디터를 지낸 Hack은 글로벌 영상 채널 Nowness의 공동 창립자이기도 하다. Jefferson Hack is a British curator and creative director. He is the co-founder, editorial director and CEO of Dazed Media, an independent media company that produces content across print, digital and video brands. The company's portfolio includes fashion bi-annuals Another Magazine and Another Man; quarterly youth fashion and culture magazine Dazed, and websites Anothermag.com, Dazeddigital.com, Dazedbeauty.com and Anothermanmag.com in addition to the creative wing Dazed Studio. Hack, who previously served as Editor of these titles, is also co-founder of global video channel Nowness.

info: Jil Sander S.p.A.는 1968년 독일 함부르크에서 설립되어 현재 이탈리아 밀라노에 본사를 둔 럭셔리 패션 하우스다. Jil Sander가 설립했으며 미니멀하고 깔끔한 디자인으로 가장 잘 알려져 있다. 1999년 Prada에 인수되었고, Sander는 이후 창작상의 견해 차이로 자신의 이름을 건 레이블을 떠났다. 여러 차례 소유주가 바뀐 끝에 2021년 3월 이탈리아 패션 그룹 OTB가 인수했다. 크리에이티브 디렉터는 Simone Bellotti다. Jil Sander S.p.A. is a luxury fashion house founded in 1968 in Hamburg, Germany, and currently headquartered in Milan, Italy. Founded by Jil Sander, the brand is best known for its minimalist and clean designs. The brand was acquired by Prada in 1999 and Sander subsequently departed her eponymous label due to creative differences. After several changes of ownership, the Jil Sander brand was acquired by Italian fashion group OTB in March 2021. Simone Bellotti is the creative director.

rawContent:
>[!tldr] tl;dr
>

> [!Info]
> Jody Hudson-Powell is a multidisciplinary designer recognised for pioneering the integration of computation, craft and materiality to create dynamic brand identities and experiences. Since joining Pentagram’s London office as a partner in 2015 alongside his brother Luke Powell, they have become known for innovative, culturally impactful work that seamlessly integrates digital, physical, and spatial design with spirited creativity and polymathic curiosity.  
  
With a deeply rooted practice spanning over two decades, Jody’s work brings together coding, generative systems, and traditional tactile processes. He began exploring this intersection at Central Saint Martins before completing an MSc in Virtual Environments at the Bartlett School of Architecture, where he focused on spatial computing and immersive systems—further expanding his practice into three-dimensional space.  
  
At Pentagram, Jody leads projects that redefine how brands communicate visually and experientially. His influential work for Cohere notably reshaped expectations of AI branding by blending organic visual language with advanced computational systems, while his identity for Graphcore set benchmarks in visualising complex technological narratives, reframing perceptions within the tech industry. Other notable clients include Google, X (formerly Google X), Alphabet’s Isomorphic Labs, TwelveLabs, Pienso, and Stereolabs. In gaming and entertainment, Jody has crafted immersive identities for global brands such as Warhammer and Nuverse, and recently developed his own interactive game, Almost Light, highlighting his commitment to narrative-driven design.  
  
His work has been exhibited internationally, including at the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) in New York, as well as exhibitions in the UK, Japan, and beyond. In 2023, Jody was elected to the prestigious Alliance Graphique Internationale (AGI), acknowledging his ongoing influence within the design community.  
  
Jody regularly shares insights on the evolving intersections of technology, craftsmanship, and storytelling through public speaking, writing, and mentorship, consistently advocating for a meaningful synthesis of innovation, craft and narrative in contemporary design.

> [!Summary]
