title: Joerg Koch
tldr: `Founder, Editor-in-Chief & Creative Director` by 032c
info: Joerg Koch는 ‘생각하는 남자의 패션 매거진’ 032c의 창립자이자 편집장이며, SSENSE의 편집장이기도 하다. Koch의 매거진은 Martin Margiela를 비롯해 패션계에서 가장 과묵한 인물들로 꾸준히 채워진다. SSENSE는 월 2,200만 페이지뷰를 기록하는 글로벌 이커머스 플랫폼으로, 미국, 한국, 중국이 주요 시장이다. 032c는 “Who is Steven Meisel?”(1988~2008년 Vogue Italia 커버를 모은 16페이지 접지 아카이브가 포함된 Meisel 독점 인터뷰)나 “Hip, Hop, You Don’t Stop”(전설적인 독일 출판인 Gerhard Stiedl의 상세한 초상) 같은 기사를 만든다. 이 매거진은 Danko Steiner, Daniel Sannwald 같은 혁신적인 젊은 사진가들도 지지한다. 《Industrie》는 Koch가 “패션 출판에 제대로 된 저널리즘의 가치를 되살렸다”고 평가한다. “1999년 창간 이후 032c는 《The Face》 이래 가장 중요한 편집 의제를 세웠다는 데 의심의 여지가 거의 없다.” Koch 자신은 이 매거진과 자신의 편집 스타일을 “약에 취한 Vanity Fair”라고 표현한다. 2015년 Koch가 SSENSE의 편집장을 맡는다고 발표되었다. 캐나다 패션 이커머스 업체인 SSENSE는 Alexander McQueen, Common Projects, Vetements 등 폭넓으면서도 안목 있는 상품 구성으로 알려져 있다. Joerg Koch is the founder and editor-in-chief of 032c, the thinking man’s fashion magazine, and the editor-in-chief of SSense. Koch’s magazine is consistently filled with fashion’s most reticent figures, including Martin Margiela, while SSense a global e-commerce platform that receives 22 million page views per month and counts the US, South Korea and China as its top markets. 032c produces features such as "Who is Steven Meisel ?" (an exclusive interview with Meisel featuring a 16-page foldout archive of all his Vogue Italia covers spanning 1988 to 2008) or "Hip, Hop, You Don’t Stop" (a detailed portrait of the legendary German publisher Gerhard Stiedl). The magazine also champions innovative young photographers such as Danko Steiner and Daniel Sannwald. Industrie credits Koch with “with restoring proper journalistic values to fashion publishing. There’s little doubt that since its conception in 1999, 032c has set the most significant editorial agenda since The Face.” Koch himself describes the magazine and his editorial style as “Vanity Fair on crack.” In 2015, it was announced Koch would be helming Ssense as its editor-in-chief. The Canadian fashion e-tailer is known for its wide but discerning range of product from the likes of Alexander McQueen, Common Projects and Vetements.

title: Johan Frederik Hartle
tldr: `Rector` of Academy of Fine Arts Vienna
info: 요한 프레데리크 하르틀레는 빈 미술아카데미의 총장(Rector)이다. 이전에는 카를스루에 예술디자인대학의 임시 총장이었으며, 그곳에서 예술·미디어 이론 교수로 재직했다. 박사학위를 받은 뒤 예루살렘과 로마에서 연구 펠로십을 받았고, 이후 암스테르담대학교에서 예술철학·문화철학 조교수를 지냈다. 항저우의 중국미술학원에서 미학 겸임교수로 일했으며, 캐나다 밴쿠버 사이먼프레이저대학교 인문학연구소의 준회원이다. 그의 저작은 동시대 미술, 제도적 예술 이론, 정치적 미학, 붉은 빈(Red Vienna)의 유산에 대한 입장들을 탐구한다. 총장의 책임에는 연구, 학사, 인사, 재정, 국제 업무가 포함된다. Johan Frederik Hartle is Rector of the Academy of Fine Arts Vienna. Previously he was interim Rector of the Karlsruhe University of Arts and Design at which he held a professorship for Art and Media Theory. After obtaining his doctorate, he was granted research fellowships for Jerusalem and Rome before he became Assistant Professor for Art Philosophy and Cultural Philosophy at Amsterdam University. Hartle was Adjunct Professor of Aesthetics at the China Academy of Art in Hangzhou and is an Associated Member of the Institute for the Humanities of Simon Fraser University, Vancouver, Canada. His publications explore positions in contemporary art, institutional art theories, political aesthetics, and the legacy of Red Vienna. The Rector’s responsibilities comprise research, academia, personnel, finances and international issues.

title: JOHANNA PARV (Brand)
tldr: 에스토니아 출신 디자이너가 런던에서 이끄는 ‘기능적 럭셔리’ 여성복 레이블
info: 에스토니아 출신이 런던에서 이끄는 동명의 레이블 Johanna Parv는 여성을 위한 독특한 ‘기능적 럭셔리’를 정의하는 브랜드다. Parv가 ‘자전거 도로에서 회의실까지’ 우아하고 힘 있게 도시를 오가는 여성들에게서 영감을 얻어, 성능과 기술성에 대한 세심한 디테일과 타협 없는 우아함이 이끄는 독특하게 현대적이고 혁신적인 미학을 만든다. 스포츠웨어와 Balenciaga, Christian Dior 같은 쿠튀르 하우스에서의 배경이 녹아든 디자인 철학으로, 2022년 브랜드가 Fashion East 수혜자가 되면서 런웨이에 데뷔해 업계의 큰 호평을 받았다. 졸업 이후 권위 있는 LVMH Prize 세미파이널리스트였고 지금은 BFC Newgen 디자이너다. 디자이너가 ‘엔지니어드 포멀웨어’라고 부르는 Parv의 영역은 은근히 관능적인 코드와 기술적 요소를 융합한 것으로, ‘독립적이고 자유로운 영혼이면서 동시에 세련된’ 여성을 위해 디자인되었다. Dover Street Market, H Lorenzo, Ssense를 비롯한 주요 글로벌 리테일러에서 판매되며, 컬렉션은 레디투웨어와 액세서리에 걸쳐 있다. Estonian-born, London-based eponymous label Johanna Parv is the brand defining a unique ‘functional luxury’ offering for women. Inspired by the women Parv sees moving through the city with grace and power ‘from the bike lane to the boardroom’, Johanna Parv creates a distinctly modern and innovative aesthetic fuelled by meticulous detail to performance and technicality, and uncompromised elegance. With a design philosophy informed by a background in the worlds of sportswear and couture houses such as Balenciaga and Christian Dior, Parv’s empowering designs debuted on the runway in 2022 when the brand became a Fashion East recipient, to much industry acclaim. Since graduating, Johanna Parv has been a Semi-Finalist of the prestigious LVMH Prize and is now a BFC Newgen designer. Parv’s niche for what the designer describes as ‘engineered formalwear’ - fusing subtly sensual codes with technical elements - is designed with women who are ‘independent, free souls, but refined at the same time’. Stocked across leading global retailers including Dover Street Market, H Lorenzo and Ssense, the collection spans ready-to-wear and accessories. https://visla.kr/article/fashion/325315/

info: John Charles Galliano는 영국의 패션 디자이너다. 자신의 레이블 John Galliano와 프랑스 패션 하우스 Givenchy, Dior의 크리에이티브 디렉터를 맡았고, 2014년부터 2024년까지는 파리 기반 하우스 Maison Margiela의 크리에이티브 디렉터였다. 영국 올해의 디자이너상을 네 차례 받았고, 2004년 BBC 조사에서 영국 문화에서 다섯 번째로 영향력 있는 인물로 꼽혔다. John Charles Galliano is a British fashion designer. He was the creative director of his eponymous label John Galliano and French fashion houses Givenchy and Dior. From 2014 to 2024, Galliano was the creative director of Paris-based fashion house Maison Margiela. Galliano has been named British Designer of the Year four times. In a 2004 poll for the BBC, he was named the fifth most influential person in British culture.

> Renowned for his experience in brand strategy and visual identities, John Rushworth has worked for companies across a broad range of sectors including hospitality, luxury goods, finance, property, transport, education and start-ups. He has an in-depth approach to design, working closely with all of his clients to draw out a brand’s key attitudes, which form the basis of graphic solutions that are both strategically focused and visually compelling.

Over the past three decades John has created major projects for Kings College London, Craft’s Council, Krug, Coutts, Ten Trinity Square, One & Only Resorts, Bulgari, World Chess, Dorchester Collection, Armani Hotels, Café Royal, Marbella Club, Great Western Railway, Index Ventures, Canal & River Trust, Rathfinny Estate and Harrods.

John’s fusion of commerce and aesthetics has led him to form long relationships with his clients to support the worldwide management of their brands. These include Polaroid Corporation, The Savoy Group, Bertazzoni and Rocco Forte Hotels.

  John graduated from the Preston College of Art and started his career at [Conran Design Group](http://www.conrandesigngroup.com/) before joining Pentagram in 1983. In 1987 he became Pentagram’s first associate and in 1989 was the first employee to be invited to become a partner of the firm.

  John is a prominent figure in the design community. He has been member of the [Alliance Graphique Internationale (AGI)](http://a-g-i.org/) since 1994 and a Director of the [Outset Contemporary Art Fund](https://outset.org.uk/) since 2012. His work has been exhibited worldwide and has received many international awards including a gold medal at the Lahti Poster Biennale and multiple [D&AD](https://www.dandad.org/) silver pencils. He has been an external assessor at [Falmouth College of Art](https://www.falmouth.ac.uk/falmouth-school-of-art) and the University of Lancashire.

info: John Patrick Ternus(1975년 5월생)는 2026년 9월부터 Apple의 최고경영자(CEO)를 맡고 있는 미국의 엔지니어이자 경영인이다. 2001년 Apple 제품 디자인팀에 합류했고, 2021년부터 2026년까지 하드웨어 엔지니어링 수석 부사장을 지냈다. Apple은 그가 iPad와 AirPods 제품군 작업에 기여했다고 평가하며, 맥이 인텔 프로세서에서 애플 실리콘으로 전환하던 시기에 하드웨어 엔지니어링을 총괄했다. John Patrick Ternus (; born May 1975) is an American engineer and business executive who has been the chief executive officer (CEO) of Apple since September 2026. Ternus joined Apple's product design team in 2001, and was the company's senior vice president of hardware engineering from 2021 to 2026. Apple has credited Ternus with work on the iPad and AirPods product lines, and he oversaw hardware engineering during the company's transition from Intel processors to Apple silicon in Mac computers. Upon inheriting Dan Riccio's position as senior vice president of hardware engineering, it has been widely reported by tech analysts that he has radically changed Apple's hardware and design philosophy, pivoting Apple's hardware engineering into prioritizing function over form, marking a major departure from Jony Ive's form over function focus for Apple products.

title: Jon Marshall
info: Jon Marshall is an industrial designer whose work fuses product design with strategy, packaging, digital and physical experiences.
rawContent:
>[!tldr] tl;dr
>

> [!Info]
> Jon Marshall is an industrial designer whose work fuses product design with strategy, packaging, digital and physical experiences. 

He studied BA product design at Ravensbourne and then MA industrial design at the Royal College of Art, beginning his professional career working for Ross Lovegrove before moving to Pentagram, where he worked with Daniel Weil. In 2003 he joined Edward Barber & Jay Osgerby as Studio Director developing furniture and product designs including the 2012 London Olympic Torch. He then co-founded industrial design consultancy [Map](https://mapprojectoffice.com/) with Barber and Osgerby where he created products and experiences for clients like IBM, Honda and Virgin Atlantic.

Since becoming a partner at Pentagram in 2018, Jon has designed products, packaging and experiences for clients from startups to multinationals. His interest lies in working with abstract and emerging technologies, creating accessible user experiences and projects embracing sustainability. He has developed industrial design language programmes for pioneering tech companies Graphcore, Quandela and Lightmatter. In 2022 Jon was commissioned by UEFA to design the trophy for its new European club football competition, the Europa Conference League.

His design for the Yoto Player, a screen-free audio player for children was honoured as one of TIME's 2020 Best Inventions. In 2024, the third generation Yoto Player won an IDSA gold award, Red Dot Award, D&AD Graphite Pencil and a Good Design Award.He has designed plastic-free packaging for telecoms giant Verizon, and sustainable, letterbox-friendly packaging for brain health and wellness startup Heights. In 2022, he developed the 50th anniversary box set for Pink Floyd’s Dark Side of the Moon.

In 2023 he designed a DIY Flashlight to teach children STEM skills for Ambessa Play. Filmmaker Andrés Fraga filmed Jon and his team visiting the factories that manufacture the DIY Flashlight for a documentary called Three Days in China.

Jon was listed as one of Creative Review’s top 50 creative leaders and has served on the jury of numerous design awards including IDSA, D&AD and Pentawards.

Follow Jon on [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jonmarshalll/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/jonmarshalll/).

title: Julie Kegels
tldr: 2024년에 자신의 레이블을 시작한 벨기에 디자이너 Julie Kegels
info: 안트베르펜 왕립예술학교를 졸업한 벨기에 디자이너가 2024년 자신의 이름을 건 레이블을 시작했다. 2024-25 가을·겨울 파리 여성 패션위크에서 데뷔한 컬렉션 ‘50/50’은 서로 다른 여성 원형을 탐구하며 우아함과 장난스러움을 같은 비중에 두어 동시대 럭셔리에 도전했다. 각 컬렉션은 관습에 도전하고 입는 사람의 개성에 공명하는 옷을 만든다는 비전을 반영한다. 하나의 원형에 순응하기를 거부하려는 욕구가 브랜드를 돋보이게 하는 주제다. 개인적 기억과 현대적 영향에서 끌어온 작업은 시대를 초월한 우아함과 대담하고 앞을 내다보는 요소를 융합한다. 옷 이상의 것을 만들고, 이야기를 빚어, 여성들을 진정성과 표현적 세련미의 세계로 초대한다. Belgian designer, , a graduate of Antwerp’s Royal Academy of Fine Arts, launched her eponymous label in 2024. Debuting at Women’s Fashion Week FW24-25 in Paris, her collection 50/50 challenged contemporary luxury by exploring different female archetypes and by doing so putting elegance and playfulness in the scale. Each collection reflects vision: to challenge convention and create garments that resonate with the individuality of its wearers. The desire to defy conforming to a single archetype is a leitmotif that makes the brand stand out. Drawing from personal memories and modern influences, her work fuses timeless elegance with daring, forward-thinking elements. crafts more than clothing; she shapes a narrative, inviting women into a universe of authenticity and expressive sophistication.

> Educated in visual communication in Munich, Germany, Justus Oehler began his design career in 1985 at Büro Rolf Müller. In 1988 he attended the [Central School of Art and Design](http://www.arts.ac.uk/csm/) in London and graduated with a Master’s Degree in graphic design. In 1989 he joined Pentagram and in 1995 was invited to become a partner in the firm.  
  
Justus produces corporate identities, publications, environmental design and visual communication programmes for a diverse array of clients worldwide. The distinctly international quality of Justus’ work reflects his culturally diverse upbringing. A native of Germany, he lived in Japan as a child and attended schools in Greece and France as well as Germany and England.  
  
His work has been featured in the annual design competitions of [Communication Arts](http://www.commarts.com/), the [D&AD](http://www.dandad.org/), and several other professional groups.

title: Katie Grand
tldr: `Director` of Perfect Magazine `Contributing Fashion Creative Director` of W Magazine
info: Katie는 최근 새로운 콘텐츠 에이전시이자 매거진인 ‘The Perfect Magazine’을 설립했다. 2009년 2월 그가 창간한 콘데 나스트의 연 2회 스타일 타이틀 《LOVE》의 편집장이라는 이전 역할에 더해, Katie Grand는 최근 몇 년간 스타일을 규정한 쇼와 광고 캠페인을 다룬 높이 평가받는 스타일리스트이자 크리에이티브 컨설턴트다. 《Interview》의 시니어 컨트리뷰팅 패션 에디터, 《GQ》의 컨트리뷰팅 패션 에디터이며, 《Vogue Paris》, 《Vogue Japan》, 《Vogue Homme International》의 정기 기고자이기도 하다. Katie Grand는 영국의 스타일리스트, 크리에이티브 디렉터, 패션 저널리스트다. 2009년 패션 매거진 《LOVE》를 창간했고, 이어 2020년 패션 바이블이자 크리에이티브 에이전시 Perfect를 만들었다. Katie has recently set up the new content agency and magazine 'The Perfect Magazine' In addition to her previous role as Editor-in-Chief of LOVE Magazine, the biannual Condé Nast style title she founded in February 2009, Katie Grand is a highly regarded stylist and creative consultant, working on some of the most style-defining shows and advertising campaigns of recent years. She is also Senior Contributing Fashion Editor of Interview Magazine, Contributing Fashion Editor of GQ, and regular contributor to Vogue Paris, Vogue Japan, and Vogue Homme International. Katie Grand is a British stylist, creative director and fashion journalist. She founded the fashion magazine LOVE in 2009, followed by fashion bible and creative agency Perfect in 2020.

title: Katie Reese
tldr: `Chief Executive Officer` of Toronto Film School
info: 케이티 리스는 토론토 필름 스쿨의 최고경영자(CEO)로, 새 프로그램, 제휴, 주요 전략 프로젝트를 추진하는 책임을 맡고 있다. Yorkville Education Company에 합류하기 전에는 Birch Hill Equity Partners에서 포트폴리오 운영 부문 부사장으로, 그 전에는 CIBC Capital Markets의 투자은행 부문에서 일했다. 케이티는 교육에 열정이 있어 뇌샤텔 주니어 칼리지 기금의 의장을 맡고 있으며 교도소 문해 이니셔티브(Prison Literacy Initiative)에서 자원봉사를 했다. 퀸스대학교에서 상학사(BComm, 최우등)와 생명과학 학사(BSc, 우등)를 모두 마쳤고 총장 장학생이었다. Katie Reese is the Chief Executive Officer at Toronto Film School, responsible for enabling new programs, partnerships and key strategic projects. Prior to joining Yorkville Education Company, Katie worked for Birch Hill Equity Partners as Vice President – Portfolio Operations, and prior to that worked for CIBC Capital Markets in investment banking. Katie is passionate about education and serves as the Chair of the Neuchatel Junior College Fund, and has volunteered with the Prison Literacy Initiative. Katie completed both her BComm (First Class Honours) and BSc Life Science (Distinction) at Queen’s University where she was a Chancellor’s Scholar.

> Kelly O’Keefe is a business strategist known for his work in organizational brand strategy.

He has been a strategic advisor to a wide range of global corporate clients, including Capital One, Dominion Energy, Harvard, MIT, Microsoft, Disney, ESPN, CarMax, Walmart, UPS, and KitchenAid. Kelly has also advised two US senators, five governors, and the US Department of Commerce on branding issues.

Founder of Brand Federation, Kelly's commentary on brands and creativity has been featured in dozens of media outlets, including CNN, Fox News, MSNBC, PBS, The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Fast Company, Inc., and The Washington Post.

He has been inducted into the Virginia Communications Hall of Fame and was named Virginia Entrepreneur of the Year. He was a contributing author on the book _Beyond Advertising_ published by the Wharton School of Business.

O’Keefe is the Past Chair of the Virginia Humanities board and sits on the boards of the Future of Advertising Project at the University of Pennsylvania Wharton School of Business and the Branch Museum of Design.

title: Kevin Porter
tldr: `Deputy Director` of Royal College of Music
info: 케빈 포터는 1994년부터 일해 온 왕립음악대학의 부총장(Deputy Director)으로, 국제 사업, 거버넌스, 전략에 특히 중점을 두고 대학 행정을 이끈다. 초기 경력은 품질 보증 분야에서 시작해 이스트런던대학교와 국가학위수여위원회(CNAA)에서 일했다. 이후 런던 길드홀대학교로 옮겨 거버넌스와 학사 정책, 품질 보증 업무를 맡았다. 대학행정가협회(AUA)의 전문 평가위원, 영국 음악원 연합(Conservatoires UK) 학사행정위원회 의장을 지냈고, 새로운 입학 서비스인 UCAS Conservatoires를 개발하는 CUK 사업을 이끌기도 했다. 현재 로열 앨버트 홀 평의회 위원이며 2022년까지 KCG 내부감사 컨소시엄 이사회 의장을 맡았고, 여러 고등교육 기관에도 참여하고 있다. 논문 「미래 음악원의 경영: 행정인가 리더십인가?」(Management in the Conservatoire of the Future: administering or leading?)를 1998년 『Studies in Higher Education』에 발표했으며, 제프리 윅스 OBE와 함께 구술사 『Between the acts: lives of homosexual men, 1885-1967』을 공동 편집했다. Kevin Porter is Deputy Director of the Royal College of Music, where he has worked since 1994, leading the administration of the College, with a particular focus on international initiatives, governance and strategy. His early career was in quality assurance, first at the University of East London and then for the Council for National Academic Awards. He then moved to London Guildhall University where he worked in governance and academic policy, as well as Quality Assurance. Kevin was a Specialist Assessor for the Association of University Administrators, Chairman of the Conservatoires UK Academic Administration Committee and he also chaired the CUK initiative to develop a new admissions service, UCAS Conservatoires. He is currently a member of the Royal Albert Hall Council and he chaired the Board of KCG internal audit consortium until 2022, among an involvement in a range of HE sector organisations. His article ‘Management in the Conservatoire of the Future: administering or leading?’ was published in journal Studies in Higher Education in 1998 and, with Jeffrey Weeks OBE, he co-edited the oral history ‘Between the acts : lives of homosexual men, 1885-1967’.

title: Kiko Kostadinov
tldr: 런던에 기반한 불가리아 출신 패션 디자이너
info: Kiko Kostadinov(불가리아어: Кико Костадинов, 1989년생)는 런던에 기반한 불가리아의 패션 디자이너다. 현재 자신의 이름을 딴 레이블과 ASICS와의 협업 브랜드 Novalis의 크리에이티브 디렉터다. 전에는 영국 헤리티지 브랜드 Mackintosh의 프리미엄 라인 Mackintosh 0001의 크리에이티브 디렉터였다. 그의 작업은 현대적인 유니폼과 동시대 워크웨어를 중심으로 한다. Kiko Kostadinov (Bulgarian: Кико Костадинов; born 1989) is a Bulgarian fashion designer based in London. He currently is the creative director of his eponymous label as well as Novalis, an ongoing collaborative brand with ASICS. He previously was the creative director of British heritage brand Mackintosh's premium line Mackintosh 0001. Kostadinov's work is centered on modern-day uniform and contemporary workwear.

> ### Analytical Graphics at the HFBK Hamburg

The Hochschule für bildende Künste Hamburg (HFBK) is an artistic and scientific university. It offers a wide range of subjects, allowing students to study for an extensive combination of artistic and scientific qualifications. At its heart are the artistic studies chosen by students, plus project-specific and experimental working methods. In line with the strengths of free artistic learning, students are not bound to follow a fixed curriculum: there is no rigid structure of sequential units of learning content. Students work in studios, and are given intensive support by tutors in individual and group tutorials.

title: La Fémis
tldr: `Art School` based in Paris
info: La Fémis는 1986년 1901년 법에 따른 비영리 단체로 설립되었으며, 오늘날에는 공공 산업·상업 기관(1996년 12월 16일 법과 1998년 5월 13일 시행령)이다. 학교의 주요 활동은 영화 직종에 대한 기초 교육이다. 감독, 촬영감독, 프로듀서, 시나리오 작가, 편집자, 사운드 엔지니어, 미술감독, 스크립터, 배급업자, 극장 운영자 분야를 가르친다. 2013년 새 학기에 두 개의 새 과정이 만들어졌는데, '시리즈 집필·창작'과 박사과정(파리 과학·문학 대학 PSL의 SACRe 박사학교 소속)이다. Créée en 1986 sous la forme d’une association loi de 1901, La Fémis est aujourd’hui un établissement public industriel et commercial (loi du 16 décembre 1996 et décret du 13 mai 1998). L’activité principale de l’École est la formation initiale aux métiers du cinéma : réalisateur, chef opérateur, producteur, scénariste, monteur, ingénieur du son, décorateur, scripte, distributeur et exploitant de salles. Deux nouveaux cursus ont été créés à la rentrée 2013 : « Ecriture et création de séries » et doctorat (dans le cadre de l’école doctorale SACRe de l’université Paris Sciences et Lettre (PSL)).

title: Larry Page
tldr: Sergey Brin과 Google을 공동 창업한 미국 사업가·컴퓨터 과학자
info: Lawrence Edward Page(1973년 3월 26일생)는 Sergey Brin과 함께 Google을 공동 창업한 미국의 사업가이자 컴퓨터 과학자다. 1997년부터 2001년 8월까지 Google의 CEO였고(Eric Schmidt가 후임), 2011년 4월부터 2015년 7월까지 다시 CEO를 맡은 뒤 새로 설립된 모회사 Alphabet의 CEO가 되어 2019년 12월 4일 Brin과 함께 모든 경영 직책에서 물러났다. 현재도 Alphabet의 이사이자 직원이며 두 지배 주주 중 한 명이다. Google 검색 순위 알고리즘 PageRank의 공동 창안자이자 이름의 유래이며, 공동 저자 Brin과 함께 2004년 마르코니상을 받았다. Lawrence Edward Page (born March 26, 1973) is an American businessman and computer scientist who co-founded Google with Sergey Brin. Page was chief executive officer of Google from 1997 until August 2001 when he was succeeded by Eric Schmidt, and then again from April 2011 until July 2015 when he became CEO of its newly formed parent organization Alphabet Inc. He held that post until December 4, 2019, when he and Brin stepped down from all executive positions and day-to-day roles within the company. He remains an Alphabet board member, employee, and one of two controlling shareholders. Page is the co-creator and namesake of PageRank, a search ranking algorithm for Google for which he received the Marconi Prize in 2004 along with co-writer Brin.

Laura Csocsán is an independent graphic and type designer from Budapest, Hungary, currently based in Lausanne, Switzerland. Her practice starts where graphic and type design intersect. She regularly creates custom typographical solutions for clients and collaborators in the field of music, culture, and art. Besides her focus on printed matter, magazines, books and identities, she's producing and distributing retail typefaces through Laura Csocsan Typefaces.

title: Leo Porto
tldr: `Founder & Creative Director` of PORTO ROCHA
info: Leo Porto는 뉴욕에 기반을 둔 브라질 출신 크리에이티브 디렉터이자 PORTO ROCHA의 공동 창립자다. 그의 작업은 브랜드 아이덴티티 시스템을 중심으로, 정밀하면서도 표현적인 견고한 틀을 문화와 함께 확장하고 진화하도록 설계하는 데 있다. 스튜디오를 설립하기 전에는 COLLINS의 디자인 디렉터였고 Pentagram, Mother, Chermayeff & Geismar & Haviv에서 일했다. 뉴욕 School of Visual Arts에서 타이포그래피를 가르쳤으며 D&AD, The One Club, Print Magazine, Type Directors Club 등의 상과 매체에서 인정받았다. Leo Porto is a NY-based Brazilian creative director and co-founder of PORTO ROCHA. His work centers around brand identity systems, building robust frameworks that are both precise and expressive — designed to scale and evolve with culture. Prior to founding the studio, Leo was a Design Director at COLLINS and worked at Pentagram, Mother, and Chermayeff & Geismar & Haviv. He has taught typography at the School of Visual Arts in New York, and has been recognized by awards and publications including D&AD, The One Club, Print Magazine, and The Type Directors Club.

Prior to founding the studio, Leo was a Design Director at COLLINS and worked at Pentagram, Mother, and Chermayeff & Geismar & Haviv. He has taught typography at the School of Visual Arts in New York, and has been recognized by awards and publications including D&AD, The One Club, Print Magazine, and The Type Directors Club.

title: London College of Communication
tldr: `Art School` based in London
info: 런던 커뮤니케이션 대학(London College of Communication)은 런던예술대학교(UAL)를 이루는 단과 칼리지다. 인쇄·소매업 교육에서 출발했으며, 지금은 광고, 애니메이션, 영화, 그래픽 디자인, 사진, 사운드 아트 같은 미디어 관련 분야를 전문으로 한다. 학생은 약 5,000명이고 학부·대학원 과정 약 60개를 제공한다. 미디어, 디자인, 스크린의 3개 학부로 이루어져 있으며 모두 엘리펀트 앤드 캐슬의 한 건물에 있다. 2004년 지금의 이름을 얻었고, 그 전에는 London School of Printing and Graphic Arts, London College of Printing, 잠깐 동안 London College of Printing and Distributive Trades로 불렸다. The London College of Communication is a constituent college of the University of the Arts London. Its origins are in education for the printing and retail industries; it now specialises in media-related subjects including advertising, animation, film, graphic design, photography and sound arts. It has approximately 5,000 students, and offers about sixty courses at undergraduate and postgraduate level. It is organised in three schools: media, design and screen; all are housed in a single building in Elephant and Castle. It received its present name in 2004; it was previously the London School of Printing and Graphic Arts, then the London College of Printing, and briefly the London College of Printing and Distributive Trades.

title: LOOSE
tldr: `Creative Director` of Fred again..
info: LOOSE는 크리에이티브 파워하우스다. 문화적 감수성을 지닌 감독이자 크리에이티브 디렉터로서 기억에 남는 순간을 큐레이션하고 관객에게 깊은 감정을 불러일으키는 법을 안다. 뮤직비디오에서 연출력을 인정받았으며, 그의 작업은 장난스러운 상상력과 전염성 있는 에너지가 특징이다. 흐름을 정확히 짚는 LOOSE는 바이럴 효과를 만들고 Z세대와 공명하는 법을 안다. Football Beyond Borders와 Sports Direct의 최근 캠페인은 비전문 배우와 셀러브리티 모두에게서 진정성 있는 연기를 끌어내는 능력을 보여 준다. Fred Again의 크리에이티브 디렉터(그 외 다수)로서 그의 창작물과 라이브 쇼를 총괄하고, 투어를 기획하며, 전 세계 관객을 계속 놀라게 하는 전략적으로 실험적인 결정을 내린다. LOOSE의 작업은 UKMVA, Young Director Awards, Kinsale Sharks, Creative Circle, D&AD, Radio Academy 30 under 30, Berlin Commercial Awards 등 여러 시상식에서 인정받았다. LOOSE is a creative powerhouse. A director and creative director with a culturally-attuned sensibility, she knows how to curate memorable moments and evoke profound emotions in audiences. Earning her directorial stripes in music videos, her work is characterised by a playful imagination and an infectious energy. With her finger on the pulse, LOOSE knows how to create viral impact and resonate with Gen Z. Her recent campaigns for Football Beyond Borders and Sports Direct demonstrate her ability to deliver authentic performances from non-actors and celebrity talents alike. Creative Director to Fred Again (among others), LOOSE oversees his creative output and live shows, planning tours and making strategically experimental decisions that continue to surprise audiences worldwide. LOOSE's work has been recognised at multiple awards: UKMVA, Young Director Awards, Kinsale Sharks, Creative Circle, D&AD, Radio Academy 30 under 30 and the Berlin Commercial Awards.

title: Lord Black of Brentwood
tldr: `Chairman of Council` of Royal College of Music
info: 가이 블랙은 평생을 커뮤니케이션 업계에서 보냈으며 텔레그래프 미디어 그룹의 부회장이자 언론불만위원회(Press Complaints Commission)의 전 이사다. 영연방언론연합 미디어 트러스트 의장, 세계신문협회 이사로서 국제 미디어 분야에서도 중요한 역할을 한다. 2009년부터 RCM 평의회 위원이었고 2017년 의장이 되었다. 브렌트우드 스쿨에서 음악에 대한 열정을 처음 발견했고 현재 그곳의 이사회 의장이며, 케임브리지 피터하우스 칼리지에서 역사학을 전공했다. 음악교육 초당파 의원 모임 공동 의장, 하노버 밴드의 전 의장, 제국전쟁박물관의 전 이사였다. 2010년 종신 귀족이 되었고 상원에서 미디어 문제, 음악 교육, 영연방에 관해 폭넓게 발언해 왔다. Guy Black has spent his career in the communications industry and is Deputy Chairman of Telegraph Media Group and a former Director of the Press Complaints Commission. As Chairman of the Commonwealth Press Union Media Trust and board member for the World Association of Newspapers, he also has a significant international media role. He has been a member of the RCM Council since 2009 and became Chairman in 2017. He was educated at Brentwood School – where he first discovered his passion for music, and where he is now Chairman of Governors – and then at Peterhouse, Cambridge, from which he graduated in history. He is Co-Chairman of the All-Party Parliamentary group on Music Education, a former Chairman of The Hanover Band, and a former Trustee of the Imperial War Museum. He was made a Life Peer in 2010 and has spoken widely in the House of Lords on media issues, music education and the Commonwealth.

title: Los Angeles Film School
tldr: `Art School` based in Los Angeles
info: 로스앤젤레스 필름 스쿨의 사명은 엔터테인먼트·미디어 산업의 직업 기회에 대한 준비에 집중하는 독창적인 교육 방식으로 학생들에게 영감을 주는 것이다. 우리는 기술 지식과 예술적 탐구, 창의성을 결합한 몰입형 교육과정을, 세계 최고의 엔터테인먼트 수도인 할리우드 한복판에서 업계 경험이 풍부한 전문가의 지도로 실습 중심의 학습 환경에서 제공한다. 우리의 프로그램은 최신 기술과 업계 관행에 맞춰 설계되어, 재능 있는 지망생들이 협업을 통해 자신만의 목소리를 찾고 엔터테인먼트·미디어 분야에서 커리어 목표를 이루도록 한다. The Los Angeles Film School’s mission is to inspire students with an inventive method of education that concentrates on preparation for career opportunities in the entertainment and media industries. We do this through an immersive curriculum that integrates technical knowledge with artistic exploration and creativity in a hands-on learning environment, taught by industry-experienced professionals in the heart of Hollywood, the premier entertainment capital of the world. Our programs are designed around current technology and industry practices, enabling aspiring talent to discover their individual voices through collaboration and realize their career goals in entertainment and media.

info: Louis Vuitton Malletier SAS는 1854년 Louis Vuitton이 설립한 프랑스 럭셔리 패션 하우스이자 기업이다. 대부분의 제품에 LV 모노그램이 들어가며, 럭셔리 가방과 가죽 제품부터 기성복, 신발, 향수, 시계, 주얼리, 액세서리, 선글라스, 책까지 아우른다. Louis Vuitton은 세계를 대표하는 국제 패션 하우스 중 하나다. 단독 부티크, 고급 백화점 내 입점, 웹사이트의 전자상거래로 제품을 판매한다. Louis Vuitton Malletier SAS is a French luxury fashion house and company founded in 1854 by Louis Vuitton. The label's LV monogram appears on most of its products, ranging from luxury bags and leather goods to ready-to-wear, shoes, perfumes, watches, jewellery, accessories, sunglasses, and books. Louis Vuitton is one of the world's leading international fashion houses. It sells its products through standalone boutiques, lease departments in high-end department stores, and through the e-commerce section of its website.

title: Luke Hayman
info: Luke Hayman studied graphic design at Central St. Martin’s School of Art, London, graduating in 1988. He has lived and worked in New York City since 1992. He joined Pentagram as a partner in December 2006.
rawContent:
>[!tldr] tl;dr
>

> [!Info]
> Luke Hayman studied graphic design at Central St. Martin’s School of Art, London, graduating in 1988. He has lived and worked in New York City since 1992. He joined Pentagram as a partner in December 2006.

Hayman’s wide-ranging expertise encompasses the design of magazines, books, identities and exhibitions. He has served as the design director of I.D. magazine; senior partner and associate creative director in the Brand Integration Group at Ogilvy & Mather, New York; creative director of Travel + Leisure magazine and design director of New York magazine.

Since joining Pentagram, Hayman has redesigned numerous publications including TIME, The Atlantic, Stern and publications for universities including The University of Chicago, Brown, Stanford Graduate School of Business, Princeton and Wharton. He has designed identities for Mastercard, the World Science Festival, The White House Historical Association, NextHome and the Southeastern Center for Contemporary Art. 

Hayman’s work has been recognized by the American Society of Magazine Editors, the Society for Publication Designers, D&AD, the American Institute of Graphic Arts and the Art Directors Club. His design for The National’s album ‘Sleep Well Beast’ was nominated for a Grammy.

Hayman has served as the vice president of the Society of Publication Designers and is a member of AGI (Alliance Graphique Internationale). He has lectured at design conferences all over the world, has taught at the School of Visual Arts and regularly lectures at the Columbia School of Journalism.

> [!Summary]

title: Luke Powell
info: Originally hailing from Somerset, England, Luke Powell—together with his brother and life-long creative collaborator Jody—joined Pentagram as a partner in 2015, following the decade-long success of their independent studio Hudson-Powell. rawContent:
>[!tldr] tl;dr
>

> [!Info]
> Originally hailing from Somerset, England, Luke Powell—together with his brother and life-long creative collaborator Jody—joined Pentagram as a partner in 2015, following the decade-long success of their independent studio Hudson-Powell. Ingrained with an unrivalled interest in the world around him, Luke is led by his eclectic curiosities, from skate culture and sci-fi fantasy to Mother Nature and music; driven by his native appetite for story and understanding. It is with this earnest and wondering creative approach that Luke walks a unique balance between technicality and design.  
  
Having begun his professional career whilst studying at Central Saint Martins, Luke endeavoured to stretch the definition of design as far as he could—exploring the sonic and interactive potential of books, type and tech. Enthralled at the interplay between the analogue, virtual and conceptual. Soon after graduating, Luke began working with the London-based creative studio The Kitchen, where he found himself thrown headfirst into the music scene, providing him with the initial space to continue challenging technology’s role and relationship with artistry. Moving between fields of study across design studios before establishing Hudson-Powell, Luke continued to learn from industry experts and imaginative niches, harnessing this cumulative prowess whilst working as Design Director of Wolff Olins alongside his creative partner, Jody.  
  
Working with cultural and commercial brands, Luke’s comprehensive client list features greats from a compelling mixture of genres and fields of study—be it the likes of musical heavy-hitters Gorillaz and PJ Harvey or commercial juggernauts Google and Coca-Cola. Contributing his unrivalled insight and creative artistry to each and every project.  
  
Truly excited by technological development, alongside his conceptual fascinations, Luke considers himself a digital optimist; not staying bogged down in self-indulgent dystopian discussions. Instead, Luke brings this technicality and masterful manipulation of technology into his creative processes – merging the technical with the practical and conceptual. It is within this invention of systems and the extra conceptual depth that Luke distils within projects that results in something truly unique.

> [!Summary]

title: MA Filmmaking (London Film School)
tldr: `Master` in filmmaking of London Film School
info: MA Filmmaking은 창작의 목소리를 발전시키고 고급 기술을 익혀 세계 영화·TV 산업에서 경력을 시작하도록 설계된 2년(24개월) 전일제 과정입니다. 첫날부터 야심 찬 오리지널 작업을 만들며, 다섯 개 모듈에서 영화 제작을 역사·문화·산업적 맥락에서 탐구하고 극영화와 다큐멘터리의 전문 작업 흐름을 익힙니다. 어떤 MA 영화 제작 과정보다 많은 영화를 만드는 것이 특징입니다. The MA Filmmaking course is designed for you to develop your creative voice, master advanced technical skills, and launch a career in the global film and TV industries. Across five focused modules, you’ll explore filmmaking in its historical, cultural, and industry contexts while gaining confidence with professional workflows in both narrative and documentary production. MA Filmmaking is a 24 month (2 year) full time course split across five modules of study, over six terms.

>[!tldr] tl;dr
> `Founder` of [[MAD]]

> [!Info]
> Ma Yansong is the founder of MAD and one of the most influential architects working today. His practice moves beyond the conventions of modernism and commercial development, emphazing emotion, spiritual experience, and.human connection. In his vision, architecture is not merely physical space, but a link between people, cities and nature.

Under his creative leadership, MAD has gained international recognition for its fluid, organic architectural language. His work also extends into exhibitions, publishing, product design and the arts, crossing disciplines and expanding the boundaries of architectural thinking.

In 2010, Ma received the RIBA International Fellowship. In 2025, he was named to the TIME100 list of the world’s most influential people. That same year, he served as curator of the China Pavilion at the Venice Architecture Biennale, further cementing his role as a cultural voice on the international stage. In 2026, he became guest editor-in-chief of Domus and was elected an Honorary Fellow of the American Institute of Architects (Hon. FAIA).

Ma a bachelor's degree from Beijing University of Civil Engineering and Architecture and a master's degree in architecture from Yale University.He has taught at University of Southern California, Tsinghua University, and Beijing University of Civil Engineering and Architecture.

title: ma-te-ri-al
tldr: 스루패스로서의 비평을 지향하는 한국 무빙이미지 비평 매체
info: 마테리알은 스루패스로서의 비평을 지향한다. 축구에서 스루 볼로도 알려져 있는 스루패스는 공격하는 팀의 선수가 상대 팀의 후방에 있는 두 명의 수비수 사이로 또는 수비진의 틈을 “관통하여”, 수비수 뒤편이지만 골키퍼는 접근할 수 없는 열린 공간(open space)으로 보내는 패스이다. 사람에게 패스하는 것이 아니라, 비어있는 공간으로 패스하는 것이기 때문에 공간패스라고도 불린다. 스루패스를 하는 선수가 열려 있는 공간에 대한 비전을 가지고 패스를 하면, 스루패스를 받는 선수는 공이 도착할 공간으로 스프린트 한다. 따라서 스루패스를 성공적으로 실행하려면 우선 스루패스가 가능할 것인지에 대한 상황적 판단이 필요하고, 또 패스하는 선수와 패스받는 선수가 각각 패스하고 스프린트 하는 타이밍이 잘 맞아야 하고, 마지막으로 패스가 옳은 페이스(right pace), 즉 적절한 "힘"과 "속도"를 갖추는 것이 필요하다. 비평을 예술 작품에 대한 단순한 반응이 아니라 그것과 상호작용하는 예술적 실천으로 보고자 한다면, 스루패스로서의 비평이라는 은유를 말해봄직하다. 이때 패스를 하는 선수와 패스를 받는 선수는 각각 비평(비평가)과 예술작품(작가)으로 고정되는 것이 아니라 뒤바뀔 수도 있다. 즉, 비평이 작품에 스루패스를 보낼 수도 있고, 반대로 작품이 비평에 스루패스를 보낼 수도 있는 것이다. 스루패스의 중요한 효과는 바로 열려진 공간(open space)을 창출하는 것이다. 이 열려진 공간은 기회의 공간이기도한데, 왜냐면 축구 경기에서 뒷공간을 침범당한 수비라인은 질서를 잃고 상대 팀의 공격에 취약해지기 때문이다. 재능있는 공격수에게 그러한 순간은 골을 넣거나 골에 직접 연관되는 플레이를 할 수 있는 기회다. 따라서 비평/작품으로부터 스루패스를 받은 작품/비평은 기존의 질서가 잠시 교란된 틈을 타 ‘골’에 준하는 어떤 기회를 얻을 수 있는 것이다. 우리는 우리의 비평이 작품 혹은 작가에게 동적 공간을 만들어주는 스루패스로서 기능하기를 소망하며, 동시에 우리의 비평에 동적 공간을 만들어주는 작품 혹은 작가의 스루패스를 받기를 희망한다. 이를 위해서 동시대 한국 무빙이미지 리서치를 진행하고 적절한 “힘”과 “속도”를 갖춘 비평을 씀으로써 작품과 비평 그 둘의 선순환을 도모하고자 한다. 이 선순환 운동은 스루패스가 결코 ‘오프사이드(off-side)’가 아니라는 전제 위에서만 가능하다. 다시 말해, 상대 팀의 수비수 너머로 우리의 비평자 혹은 창작자가 먼저 도착해 있어선 안 될 거란 뜻이다. 이는 곧 플레이의 안일함, 나아가 윤리와 관련한다. 비평과 예술작품이 서로에게 미리 짜인 싸인을 의례적으로 주고받거나 특정한 영역을 할당 및 점유하는 식에 머문다면, 만약 그리하여 구태의연한 자화자찬만을 벌여놓는 꼴이 된다면, 열린 공간/동적 공간은커녕 그저 닫힘 내지 죽은 공간을 부산해낼 뿐일 테다. 그건 반칙이다. 우리의 플레이는 서로에 대한 서비스가 아니다. 조기축구회의 친목도모는 더더욱. 역설적이게도 그렇기 때문에 우리는 우리의 실책까지도 용인할 수 있어야 할 것이다. 봐주기가 아닌, 다음 전략 수립을 위한 현재의 냉철한 진단으로서. 때로는 누군가 우리를 향해 야유를 퍼붓거나 심지어는 내기를 걸 수도 있겠지만, 우리는 그에 덩달아 일희일비하지 말아야 할 테다. 대신 우리는 끊임없이 움직여야 한다. 바로 그 움직이는 공간 안에서 말이다. 골을 넣지 않고 싶은 플레이어가 어디 있겠는가. 하지만 그렇다고 하여 반칙을 해선 안 되듯, 마찬가지로 공들인 실책을 주저해서는 안 된다. 실책해도 된다. 어쩌면 매번 그럴지도 모른다. 다만, 위로와 격려 따위로 송별하지 말자. 자책과 타책으로 소격하지 않으며, 옳은 페이스의 근육을 기르는, 공책(共同責)의 백지(百智)를 써 내려가자. 아직 경기는 끝나지 않았으니까. 다시 한번, 우리는 ‘플레이어’다. 코치도, 감독도, 캐스터도, 해설위원도, 훌리건도, 더군다나 오이디푸스도 조기축구회 회원도 아닌 플레이어. (2020년 3월 증보) “The through pass in soccer, also known as the soccer through ball, is a pass sent between two back defenders, or “through” a gap in the defense, into open space behind the defenders and out of the reach of the goalkeeper. The pass is directed to a teammate who, after first being careful to be in an onside position at the moment the ball is passed, sprints to receive the ball in the open space.  Successful execution of the through pass requires recognition that the opportunity for the pass is available, that the passer and the receiver time the pass and the run properly, and that the pass has just the right pace (“weight” or “speed”) to be effectively intersected by the receiver.” If we see critique not as a simple response to an artwork, but rather as an artistic practice which interacts with the artwork, we can suggest a metaphor: critique as a through pass. Here the passer and the receiver are not fixed as the critique(critic) and the artwork(artist), roles can be reversed. In other words a critique can send a through pass to an artwork, and an artwork can also to a critique. The important result of a through pass is the creation of open space. This open space is at the same time a space of opportunity – in a soccer game, with the back space invaded, the defense line is more likely to lose its order and be more vulnerable to attacks. For talented strikers, this moment is the opportunity to score a goal or directly participate in scoring one. Thus an artwork/critique, receiving a through pass from a critique/artwork, can get an opportunity of what is equivalent to a “goal” when the existing order is momentarily disturbed. We hope our critiques would act as a through pass, creating dynamic space for an artwork or an artist, and at the same time hope to receive one from an artwork or an artist, which would create dynamic space for our critiques. To accomplish this, we research current moving-image in Korea and produce critiques with just the right “weight” and “speed” to devise this virtuous cycle of critique and artwork. Nevertheless, this cycle stands on a condition that the pass is not an “offside.” That is, our critic/artist must not arrive behind the defenders, before the ball does. This means an indolent play, and furthermore touches with the morals. When critiques and artworks perfunctorily exchange signs planned beforehand, or when each critique or artwork merely takes possession of the assigned area, thus when they only remain as a layout of self-approbation, “open space” or “dynamic space” can never be made – it would only produce “closed space” or “dead space.” This is a foul play. Our game is not a service for each other, much less a friendship in morning soccer clubs. Thus, paradoxically, we should admit our own errors – not as an overlook, but as a keen diagnosis for the next strategy. Sometimes hecklings can be hard and loud, or we could even be betted on. Yet we must not ride on emotions upon them. Instead we must constantly run, in that very place where the ground shifts. No player would not want to make a goal. Nevertheless we must not play foully, nor must not hesitate to make an effortful error. Errors could be made. Maybe every attempt could turn out as an error. Even so, do not give them a farewell with such consolation and mere encouragement, nor enstrange ourselves with (self-)blames. We must strengthen ourselves of the “right pace,” filling up the blank pages. The game is not yet over. Once again, we are “players.” Not a coach, a manager, a sport caster, a commentator nor a hooligan. Even less not Oedipus, nor a morning soccer club member, but again, a player. (supplemented in MAR, 2020)

> 역설적이게도 그렇기 때문에 우리는 우리의 실책까지도 용인할 수 있어야 할 것이다. 봐주기가 아닌, 다음 전략 수립을 위한 현재의 냉철한 진단으로서. 때로는 누군가 우리를 향해 야유를 퍼붓거나 심지어는 내기를 걸 수도 있겠지만, 우리는 그에 덩달아 일희일비하지 말아야 할 테다. 대신 우리는 끊임없이 움직여야 한다. 바로 그 움직이는 공간 안에서 말이다. 골을 넣지 않고 싶은 플레이어가 어디 있겠는가. 하지만 그렇다고 하여 반칙을 해선 안 되듯, 마찬가지로 공들인 실책을 주저해서는 안 된다. 실책해도 된다. 어쩌면 매번 그럴지도 모른다. 다만, 위로와 격려 따위로 송별하지 말자. 자책과 타책으로 소격하지 않으며, 옳은 페이스의 근육을 기르는, 공책(共同責)의 백지(百智)를 써 내려가자. 아직 경기는 끝나지 않았으니까.
>
> 다시 한번, 우리는 ‘플레이어’다. 코치도, 감독도, 캐스터도, 해설위원도, 훌리건도, 더군다나 오이디푸스도 조기축구회 회원도 아닌 플레이어. (2020년 3월 증보)
>
> “The through pass in soccer, also known as the soccer through ball, is a pass sent between two back defenders, or “through” a gap in the defense, into open space behind the defenders and out of the reach of the goalkeeper. The pass is directed to a teammate who, after first being careful to be in an onside position at the moment the ball is passed, sprints to receive the ball in the open space.  Successful execution of the through pass requires recognition that the opportunity for the pass is available, that the passer and the receiver time the pass and the run properly, and that the pass has just the right pace (“weight” or “speed”) to be effectively intersected by the receiver.”
>
> If we see critique not as a simple response to an artwork, but rather as an artistic practice which interacts with the artwork, we can suggest a metaphor: critique as a through pass. Here the passer and the receiver are not fixed as the critique(critic) and the artwork(artist), roles can be reversed. In other words a critique can send a through pass to an artwork, and an artwork can also to a critique.
>
> The important result of a through pass is the creation of open space. This open space is at the same time a space of opportunity – in a soccer game, with the back space invaded, the defense line is more likely to lose its order and be more vulnerable to attacks. For talented strikers, this moment is the opportunity to score a goal or directly participate in scoring one. Thus an artwork/critique, receiving a through pass from a critique/artwork, can get an opportunity of what is equivalent to a “goal” when the existing order is momentarily disturbed. We hope our critiques would act as a through pass, creating dynamic space for an artwork or an artist, and at the same time hope to receive one from an artwork or an artist, which would create dynamic space for our critiques. To accomplish this, we research current moving-image in Korea and produce critiques with just the right “weight” and “speed” to devise this virtuous cycle of critique and artwork.
>
> Nevertheless, this cycle stands on a condition that the pass is not an “offside.” That is, our critic/artist must not arrive behind the defenders, before the ball does. This means an indolent play, and furthermore touches with the morals. When critiques and artworks perfunctorily exchange signs planned beforehand, or when each critique or artwork merely takes possession of the assigned area, thus when they only remain as a layout of self-approbation, “open space” or “dynamic space” can never be made – it would only produce “closed space” or “dead space.” This is a foul play. Our game is not a service for each other, much less a friendship in morning soccer clubs.
>
> Thus, paradoxically, we should admit our own errors – not as an overlook, but as a keen diagnosis for the next strategy. Sometimes hecklings can be hard and loud, or we could even be betted on. Yet we must not ride on emotions upon them. Instead we must constantly run, in that very place where the ground shifts. No player would not want to make a goal. Nevertheless we must not play foully, nor must not hesitate to make an effortful error. Errors could be made. Maybe every attempt could turn out as an error. Even so, do not give them a farewell with such consolation and mere encouragement, nor enstrange ourselves with (self-)blames. We must strengthen ourselves of the “right pace,” filling up the blank pages. The game is not yet over.
>
> Once again, we are “players.” Not a coach, a manager, a sport caster, a commentator nor a hooligan. Even less not Oedipus, nor a morning soccer club member, but again, a player. (supplemented in MAR, 2020)

> [!Summary]

rawContent:
>[!tldr] tl;dr
>

> [!Info]
> ​Maddalena Fossati is Editor in Chief of La Cucina Italiana and Head of Editorial Content of Condé Nast Traveller Italia.

Since joining Condé Nast in 2010 as Lifestyle Editor of Vanity Fair Italia, she has developed extensive expertise across the worlds of food, travel, and design.

An author and prominent cultural voice, she contributed in 2004 to the first Dictionary of Fashion published by Baldini & Castoldi and has written several books, including Chopard Mille Miglia (2008), La mia cucina by Antonio Guida for Mandarin Oriental (2020), and Prendo Fiato. Come ho portato la cucina italiana all’UNESCO (Maretti Manfredi Edizioni, 2025), chronicles of the institutional and cultural journey she personally led.

As President of the Promoting Committee, she coordinated the initiative that resulted, on December 10, 2025, in the inscription of the dossier “Italian cuisine, between sustainability and biocultural diversity” on UNESCO’s Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity — a historic milestone in the international recognition and promotion of Italian gastronomic culture.

Alongside her editorial career, she is also active in television: in 2019 she hosted the program Sapore Italiano for Food Network, and since 2025 she has been part of the cast of Alessandro Borghese – Celebrity Chef on TV8.

title: Maison Margiela
tldr: 1988년 Martin Margiela와 Jenny Meirens가 세운 파리의 프랑스 럭셔리 패션 하우스
info: Maison Margiela(이전 이름 Maison Martin Margiela)는 1988년 벨기에 디자이너 Martin Margiela와 Jenny Meirens가 설립해 파리에 본사를 둔 프랑스 럭셔리 패션 하우스다. 오트 쿠튀르에서 영감을 받은 아티장 컬렉션과 기성복 컬렉션을 모두 선보이며, 전자가 후자의 디자인에 영향을 준다. 제품 라인에는 여성복, 남성복, 주얼리, 신발, 액세서리, 가죽 제품, 향수, 생활 용품이 있다. 비전통적 소재를 쓴 해체적이고 아방가르드한 디자인으로 알려져 있다. Maison Margiela, formerly Maison Martin Margiela, is a French luxury fashion house founded by Belgian designer Martin Margiela and Jenny Meirens in 1988 and headquartered in Paris. The house produces both haute couture-inspired artisanal collections and ready-to-wear collections, with the former influencing the designs of the latter. Product lines include womenswear, menswear, jewellery, footwear, accessories, leather goods, perfumes and household goods. Known for deconstructive and avant-garde designs with unconventional materials.

title: Major Minority
tldr: 서울 기반의 타이포그래피 중심 그래픽 디자인 스튜디오
info: **Major Minority** is a Seoul-based graphic design studio with a strong focus on typography-driven graphic design. The studio began operating in 2023, founded by designer **Eunji Lee**, who built her professional background in branding design at Blacksheep in London as well as SPC and JOH & Company in Korea, and graphic designer **Ted Hyunhak Yoon**, who previously worked in the Netherlands alongside his practice as a visual artist. Major Minority is currently active across Korea’s cultural and arts sector as well as in the field of branding, presenting a wide range of graphic design projects. Ted Hyunhak Yoon was selected as one of _Monthly Design’s 15 Designers to Watch_ in 2023 and currently teaches graphic design at the Korea National University of Arts and Hongik University.

title: Mano Sundaresan
tldr: `Head of Editorial Content` of Pitchfork `Founder & (Ex) Editor-in-Chief` of No Bells `(Ex) Producer` of NPR
info: Pitchfork의 편집 콘텐츠 총괄로서 Mano Sundaresan은 플랫폼 전반의 Pitchfork 편집 전략과 스토리텔링의 개발과 실행을 맡는다. Sundaresan은 뉴욕에 기반을 둔 작가이자 편집자, 프로듀서다. 2021년에는 조명받지 못한 신(scene)과 젊은 작가들이 목소리를 다듬을 허브로서 음악·문화 블로그 No Bells를 창립했다. 불과 3년 만에 No Bells는 음악계의 권위 있는 목소리이자 신진 재능의 중요한 허브로 떠올랐다. Mano Sundaresan은 2024년 7월 Pitchfork에 편집 콘텐츠 총괄로 합류했다. 이전에는 독립 음악 블로그 No Bells를 창립해 편집장을 맡았다. 현재 브루클린에 산다. As head of editorial content for Pitchfork, Mano Sundaresan oversees the development and execution of Pitchfork's editorial strategy and storytelling across platforms. Sundaresan is a writer, editor and producer based in New York. In 2021, he founded the music and culture blog No Bells as a hub for under-covered scenes and for young writers to hone their voices. In just three years, No Bells emerged as a voice of authority in the music landscape and a vital hub for emerging talent. Mano Sundaresan joined Pitchfork as the head of editorial content in July 2024. Previously, he founded and served as the editor-in-chief of the independent music blog No Bells. He currently lives in Brooklyn.

> Marc Beaugé is a cultural storyteller.  
  
Trained as a journalist in Paris, Marc Beaugé began his career writing about politics, culture, and sports before  
specializing in fashion journalism. For more than a decade, he has been a columnist for Le Monde and a contributor to Quotidien, France's most-watched late-night television show. He also served as Editor-in-Chief of the renowned HOLIDAY magazine for seven years. In 2018, he launched the successful magazines L'Étiquette, which he continues to oversee today.  
  
Alongside his editorial work, Marc Beaugé advises brands seeking greater cultural relevance and creative impact. Drawing on his wide-ranging experience, he works across creative direction, brand and product consulting, as well as writing, hosting, and moderating conversations.

tldr: 상파울루에서 활동하는 프리랜서 영화 에디터, 브라질-네덜란드계
info: 브라질과 네덜란드 혈통을 함께 지닌 음악가이기도 한 Marcelo는 이미지에 리듬을 만드는 일을 좋아한다. 제 이름은 Marcelo Vogelaar이고, 상파울루 Centro Universitário Senac에서 시청각학을 전공한 영화 에디터입니다. 지난 15년간 광고, 뮤직비디오, 단편 영화, 다큐멘터리, 텔레비전 프로그램, 스트리밍 시리즈에 걸쳐 일하며 편집으로 리듬, 구조, 서사를 빚는 데 꾸준히 집중해 왔습니다. Netflix, Paramount+, Google, Amazon, Nike, Samsung, KLM, Verizon, Pinterest, Lexus, Budweiser 같은 국제적으로 인정받는 클라이언트와 플랫폼과 협업했습니다. 미국, 영국, 독일, 네덜란드, 한국, 덴마크, 멕시코에서 진행된 국제 프로덕션 작업도 있습니다. Selena Gomez, DJ Snake, Tove Lo, Anderson .Paak, Anitta, Pabllo Vittar, Duda Beat, Criolo, Marina Sena, Laurent Voulzy 같은 아티스트의 뮤직비디오를 편집했습니다. 현재는 상파울루를 기반으로 하는 프리랜서 에디터로, 국제 프로덕션에서 원격과 현장으로 협업하고 있습니다. 미국과 캐나다에서는 Church Edit(www.edit.church)가 편집 업무와 프로덕션의 에이전트로 저를 대리합니다. 포르투갈어, 영어, 스페인어를 구사합니다. Part Brazilian, part Dutch and also a musician, Marcelo loves to create rhythm in images. My name is Marcelo Vogelaar and I am a film editor, with a degree in Audiovisual Studies from Centro Universitário Senac in São Paulo. Over the past 15 years, I have worked across advertising, music videos, short films, documentaries, television programs, and streaming series, consistently focusing on shaping rhythm, structure, and narrative through editing. I have collaborated with internationally recognized clients and platforms including Netflix, Paramount+, Google, Amazon, Nike, Samsung, KLM, Verizon, Pinterest, Lexus, and Budweiser. My work includes international productions carried out in the United States, England, Germany, the Netherlands, South Korea, Denmark, and Mexico. I have edited music videos for artists such as Selena Gomez, DJ Snake, Tove Lo, Anderson .Paak, Anitta, Pabllo Vittar, Duda Beat, Criolo, Marina Sena, and Laurent Voulzy. I currently work as a freelance editor based in São Paulo, collaborating on international productions both remotely and on-site. In the United States and Canada, I am professionally represented by Church Edit (www.edit.church), acting as my agent for editorial engagements and productions. I speak Portuguese, English, and Spanish.

title: Marina Willer
tldr: `Partner` at Pentagram
info: Marina Willer는 왕립예술대학에서 그래픽 디자인 MA를 받은 그래픽 디자이너이자 영화감독이다. Pentagram에 파트너로 합류하기 전에는 런던 Wolff Olins의 총괄 크리에이티브 디렉터였다. 경력 동안 Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, Tate, 국제앰네스티, Southbank Centre, Serpentine Galleries, Oxfam, Nesta, Second Home, Moholy Nagy Foundation, 플랑드르 오페라 발레, 브라질의 Oi와 Nubank 등 주요 브랜드 아이덴티티 디자인을 이끌었다. 영국의 대표적 동물 구조 센터 Battersea, 《Sight and Sound》 매거진, Maggie’s 암 센터의 리브랜딩을 이끌었고, Macmillan Cancer Support 브랜드를 디자인한 디자이너 중 한 명이기도 했다. Willer의 첫 장편 영화 《Red Trees》는 2017년 칸 영화제에서 초연되었고 2018년 넷플릭스로 전 세계에 공개되었다. 그의 영화는 파리 까르띠에 재단, 런던 ICA, 세계적 영화제에서 상영되었다. 영국의 상징적 건축가 Richard Rogers를 위해 여러 편의 영화를 만들었는데, 퐁피두 센터와 디자인 박물관의 Rogers 전시를 소개한 〈Exposed〉와 왕립예술원에서 상영된 〈Ethos〉가 있다. 이 영화들은 Rogers 및 그의 건축 사무소 RSH+P와의 오랜 협업의 결과이며, Willer는 RSH+P의 비주얼 아이덴티티도 만들었다. 다방면의 디자이너로서 디자인 박물관의 대형 전시 ‘Ferrari: Under the Skin’과 ‘Stanley Kubrick: The Exhibition’을 디자인했다. 두 전시 모두 박물관 역사상 가장 많은 관객이 찾은 전시였다. 왕립예술대학의 심사위원을 지냈고, 세계에서 가장 권위 있는 그래픽 디자인 협회인 AGI의 회원이다. D&AD 심사위원장을 여러 번 맡았다. 수상으로는 2004년 상파울루 영화제 최우수 브라질 단편영화, 2000년 Promax 최우수 영국 홍보 영상, 2002년 Design Effectiveness Awards의 Oi 부문 그랑프리, 2007년 Macmillan 금상이 있다. Serpentine Galleries 아이덴티티는 2014년 디자인 박물관 ‘Beazley Designs of the Year’ 후보에 올랐고, Moholy-Nagy Foundation 브랜드 아이덴티티는 Dezeen Award 최종 후보였으며 2021년 D&AD 우드 펜슬을 받았다. 영국 디자인계의 선도적 인물로 꾸준히 인정받아 왔으며, 2017년 《Creative Review》 Creative Leaders, 2018년 《Design Week》 명예의 전당 헌액, 2021년 왕립예술협회(RSA)의 왕립산업디자이너(RDI) 칭호 등 다양한 영예를 받았다. Marina Willer is a graphic designer and filmmaker with an MA in Graphic Design from the Royal College of Art. Before joining Pentagram as a partner, she was head creative director for Wolff Olins in London. During the course of her career, Willer has led the design of major brand identity schemes including Rolls Royce Motor-Cars, Tate, Amnesty International, Southbank Centre, Serpentine Galleries, Oxfam, Nesta, Second Home, Moholy Nagy Foundation, Opera Ballet of Flandres, and Brazil’s Oi and Nubank among many others. Marina also lead the rebrand of Battersea (one of​ ​Britain's​ most famous animal rescue centres), _Sight and Sound_ magazine, and Maggie's cancer centres, and was also one of the designers behind the brand for Macmillan Cancer support. Willer’s first feature film, Red Trees, premiered at the 2017 Cannes Film Festival and was [released worldwide by Netflix](https://www.netflix.com/title/80206758) in 2018. Her films have been shown at [Fondation Cartier](http://fondation.cartier.com/) in Paris, the [ICA](https://www.ica.art/) in London and prestigious film festivals worldwide. Marina has made several films for iconic British architect Richard Rogers, including “Exposed” — a film to introduce Rogers' exhibition at the Pompidou Centre and the Design Museum—and “Ethos”, which was screened at the Royal Academy of Arts. The films are the result of a longstanding collaboration with Rogers and his architectural practice RSH+P, for which Willer created the visual identity. A multi-faceted designer, Willer has designed major exhibitions for the Design Museum including ‘Ferrari: Under the Skin’ and ‘Stanley Kubrick: The Exhibition’. Both were the most-visited exhibitions in the history of the Museum. She has been an examiner at the Royal College of Art and is a member of the AGI ([Alliance Graphique Internationale](http://a-g-i.org/)) the most prestigious graphic design association in the world. She has been chair of the D&AD jury on numerous occasions. Awards include best Brazilian short film at the São Paulo Film Festival, 2004, Best British Promotional Film at Promex 2000, Grand Prix for Oi at the 2002 Design Effectiveness Awards and Gold for Macmillan 2007. Her Serpentine Galleries identity was among the 2014 nominees for the Design Museum’s ‘Beazley Designs of the Year and her brand identity for the Moholy-Nagy Foundation was shortlisted for a Dezeen Award and received a D&AD Wood Pencil in 2021. Consistently recognised as a leading figure in UK design, during the course of her career Willer has been the recipient of a variety of industry honours including _Creative Review_’s [Creative Leaders 2017](https://www.creativereview.co.uk/creative-leaders-50/). In 2018 she was inducted into _Design Week_’s Hall of Fame, and in 2021 she was honoured with the title Royal Designer for Industry (RDI) by the Royal Society of Arts.

title: Mark Fisher
info: Mark Fisher was an English academic and writer from England, born in July 1968. He worked as a professor at Goldsmiths, University of London. He always had a politically focused mind and in the early 2000’s fell distraught at the worlds state of affairs and the importance of huge corporations and huge stars. Fisher, himself was far more attracted to the obscure when it came to film, music etc. This impassioned him to create a blog in 2003 called K-Punk, which is what he has become most known for. This blog chronicled the start of the digital revolution in the modern world and included commentary on what he viewed as the positive possible outcomes of the internet but also the negativity of what was as the internet became more and more to do with large corporations just as everything else.

title: Mark Zuckerberg
tldr: Facebook과 Meta Platforms를 공동 창업한 미국 사업가·프로그래머
info: Mark Elliot Zuckerberg(1984년 5월 14일생)는 소셜 미디어 서비스 Facebook과 그 모회사 Meta Platforms를 공동 창업한 미국의 사업가이자 웹마스터, 프로그래머다. 현재 Meta의 이사회 의장, CEO이자 지배 주주다. 하버드 대학교를 잠시 다녔고, 2004년 2월 룸메이트 Eduardo Saverin, Andrew McCollum, Dustin Moskovitz, Chris Hughes와 함께 Facebook을 출범시켰으며, 2012년 5월 회사를 상장했다. Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 설립을 포함해 여러 대규모 기부를 해 왔다. 그의 초기 경력과 Facebook의 성공을 다룬 영화 <소셜 네트워크>가 2010년 개봉했다. Mark Elliot Zuckerberg (; born May 14, 1984) is an American businessman, webmaster, and programmer who co-founded the social media service Facebook and its parent company Meta Platforms. He is its chairman, chief executive officer (CEO), and controlling shareholder. Zuckerberg briefly attended Harvard College, and launched Facebook there in February 2004 with his roommates Eduardo Saverin, Andrew McCollum, Dustin Moskovitz and Chris Hughes. Zuckerberg took the company public in May 2012 with majority shares. He has used his funds to organize multiple large donations, including the establishment of the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. A film based on Zuckerberg's early career, legal troubles and initial success with Facebook, The Social Network, was released in 2010. His prominence and fast rise in the technology industry has prompted political and legal attention. He has been the subject of multiple lawsuits regarding the creation and ownership of the website as well as issues such as user privacy.

title: Martin Margiela
tldr: Maison Margiela를 세운 벨기에 디자이너
info: Martin Margiela는 벨기에의 패션 디자이너이자 예술가이며, 프랑스 럭셔리 패션 하우스 Maison Margiela의 창립자다. 경력 내내 대면 인터뷰를 거절하고 사진 촬영을 피하며 낮은 자세를 유지했다. 2008년 패션을 떠난 뒤로는 그를 아이콘으로 만든 주제들을 탐구하는 예술가로 활동하고 있다. 해체주의적이고 업사이클링한 미학과 오버사이즈 실루엣으로 최근 역사에서 가장 영향력 있는 디자이너 중 한 명으로 꼽힌다. Martin Margiela is a Belgian fashion designer, artist, and founder of the French luxury fashion house Maison Margiela. Throughout his career, Margiela has maintained a low profile, refusing to grant face-to-face interviews or be photographed. Since leaving fashion in 2008, he has emerged as an artist, exploring the themes that made him an iconic figure in fashion. He is considered to be one of the most influential fashion designers in recent history for his iconic deconstructed, upcycled aesthetic and oversized silhouette.

info: ArtCenter의 그래픽 디자인 석사(MFA)로 기업 이니셔티브, 사회 운동, 정치 캠페인에 영향을 미치세요. 복잡한 아이디어를 전달하는 경계를 넓히고, 인쇄·디지털·모션·인터랙티브·패키지 디자인 해법을 만드는 실천을 합니다. 2년 또는 연장 3년 과정에서 실무적이고 전문적인 디자인 해법의 포트폴리오를 쌓고, 기업가적 실천을 기르며, 역동적인 디자인 환경에서 이끌 준비를 합니다. Impact corporate initiatives, social movements, and political campaigns with the Master of Fine Arts (MFA) in Graphic Design at ArtCenter. Extend the boundaries of communicating complex ideas and practice crafting print, digital, motion, interactive, and packaging design solutions. In our two-year or extended three-year graphic design master’s program, you’ll build a portfolio of practical and professional design solutions, cultivate entrepreneurial practices, and prepare to lead in dynamic design environments. Building on the expertise of our internationally renowned undergraduate graphic design program, the Graphic Design MFA fosters technical skills, individual craft, transmedia fluency, next-generation leadership, strategic thought, and professional development. Through courses in critical writing, narrative, typography, 3D motion graphics, cross-media branding, web design, historical analysis, and more, you’ll cultivate dexterity with the growing demands of modern “mediatecture.”

>[!tldr] tl;dr
>

> [!Info]
> Matt Willey studied graphic design at Central St. Martins in London. In 2002, he joined Vince Frost at Frost Design London before co-founding the London-based firm Studio 8 Design with Zoë Bather in 2005. He was named partner at Pentagram in 2019 after 5 years as Art Director of The New York Times Magazine, where he collaborated on a major redesign in 2014. 

At Pentagram, Willey develops branding systems, motion graphics, packaging and publication designs for a wide range of clients, including the design of the titles for “Killing Eve,” the award-winning BBC series created by Phoebe Waller-Bridge.

Willey has worked with several of the leading titles in contemporary independent publishing. He was previously the Creative Director and Senior Editor of the quarterly style magazine Port, the first Art Director of the arts magazine Elephant, Art Director of the travel and culture magazine Avaunt, and helped launch the fashion title Plastique and Scottish contemporary art magazine MAP. He completed a redesign of UK newspaper The Independent in 2013 and is currently the creative director of INQUE_,_ the literary publication he co founded with editor Dan Crowe in 2021. 

A consistent thread throughout Willey’s work is the incorporation of bespoke typefaces, which he draws for the specific contexts of the brands, publications and stories in which they appear. These custom fonts have included AType, BWord, NewPort and NSW01, some developed in collaboration with Henrik Kubel. Willey has made several of the fonts commercially available, and proceeds from select fonts are donated to charity: His MFred and TIMMONS typefaces have helped raise more than £100,000 for Cancer Research UK and Macmillan Cancer Support through the Buy Fonts Save Lives initiative.

Willey has been recognized with numerous awards. He was named Designer of the Year by Creative Review in 2014, and during his five-year tenure at The New York Times Magazine the publication was honored with SPD Magazine of the Year in 2016, SPD Brand of the Year in 2019, and more than 40 SPD gold medals. Willey’s titles for “Killing Eve” were nominated for a BAFTA Award and received a Royal Television Society Craft Award in 2019. In 2025 he received the National Design Award for Communication Design, presented by the Cooper-Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum.

Willey was elected to the Alliance Graphique Internationale (AGI) in 2015. He has served as vice chairman of The Typographic Circle and on the board of the Editorial Design Organization (EDO).

info: 커뮤니케이션 디자인 석사(M.Des)는 글래스고 예술대학 커뮤니케이션 디자인 학과가 운영하는 2년 과정입니다. 이 프로그램은 폭넓은 디자인 실천의 정의에 대해 실습 중심이자 과정 중심이며, 교육적·상업적 맥락과 관련된 디자인 이론의 원리 습득에도 힘씁니다. 시각·텍스트 연구를 탐구하는 엄밀한 방법을 제공하며, 사회 속 디자이너의 역할과 개인적·사회적 책임에 관한 근본적 질문을 던집니다. 모든 GSA 학위 과정은 글래스고 대학교의 인증을 받습니다. The Master of Design (M.Des) in Communication Design is a two year programme delivered by the Department of Communication Design at The Glasgow School of Art. The programme is practice-led and process-oriented in relation to definitions of broad design practices. It is also committed to the acquisition of principles within design theory relating to educational and commercial contexts. The programme provides rigorous methods for the interrogation of visual and textual research, positing questions relating to the role of the designer in society, and fundamental questions regarding personal and social responsibility. All GSA degree programmes are validated by the University of Glasgow.

info: Melanie McElduff는 다양하고 세련된 클라이언트를 위해 브랜드를 개발하고 관리해 온 20년 이상 경력의 그래픽 디자이너이자 프로젝트 매니저다. 디자이너, 브랜드 매니저, 크리에이티브 디렉터로서 코넬대학교, 미들베리 칼리지, 프린스턴 대학 출판부, 허스트 코퍼레이션, 미국 의회도서관, 개리슨 인스티튜트, Satori Software, 배서 칼리지, Lodgeworks, 허시혼 미술관 및 조각 공원, Archer Hotels, Presto Packaging, Charlie Palmer Restaurant Group, NYU의 브레넌 사법센터 등 기관과 기업을 위해 아이덴티티 디자인과 가이드라인 개발부터 전시, 패키지, 인쇄·디지털 커뮤니케이션 디자인까지 일했다. Sappi의 디자인 지원 프로그램 ‘Ideas that Matter’를 세 차례 받았다. 일리노이대학교에서 그래픽 디자인 BFA를 받은 뒤 2003년 이 회사에 합류했다. Melanie McElduff is a graphic designer and project manager with over 20 years of experience developing and managing brands for a varied and sophisticated clientele. As a designer, brand manager, and creative director, she has worked with institutions and companies including Cornell University, Middlebury College, Princeton University Press, Hearst Corporation, Library of Congress, The Garrison Institute, Satori Software, Vassar College, Lodgeworks, Hirshhorn Museum & Sculpture Garden, Archer Hotels, Presto Packaging, Charlie Palmer Restaurant Group, and the Brennan Center for Justice at NYU, on tasks ranging from identity design and guidelines development, to the design of exhibitions, packaging, and print and digital communications. She is a three-time recipient of the Sappi, Ideas that Matter design grant. Melanie joined this firm in 2003 after graduating with a BFA in Graphic Design from the University of Illinois.

info: CalArts MFA 그래픽 디자인 학생들은 창립 이래 디자인 분야를 형성하는 데 중요한 역할을 해 온 프로그램의 활기차고 친밀한 스튜디오 공동체에 참여합니다. 수업, 멘토링, 비평, 학제 간 탐구를 거쳐 엄밀한 논문 작업으로 마무리하는 과정에서, 디자이너는 실무 기량을 갈고닦으면서 평생의 예술적·직업적 실천을 지탱할 역사·이론·폭넓은 문화적 소양의 토대를 세웁니다. 이 프로그램은 경험 있는 디자이너와 이 분야가 처음인 사람 모두를 위한 트랙을 갖추고 있습니다. CalArts MFA Graphic Design students participate in a vibrant, intimate studio community in a program that has, since its founding, played a significant role in shaping the field of design. Through a combination of coursework, mentorship, critique, and cross-disciplinary exploration, that culminates in a period of rigorous thesis work, designers hone their practical skills while establishing the foundation of history, theory, and broad cultural literacy to sustain a lifelong artistic and professional practice. With tracks intended for both experienced designers and those new to the discipline, the curriculum in MFA in Graphic Design program at CalArts is based on the Institute’s critical approach of contextualizing praxis in history, theory, and in the Graphic Design program’s inclusive pedagogy.

>
> CalArts MFA Graphic Design students participate in a vibrant, intimate studio community in a program that has, since its founding, played a significant role in shaping the field of design. Through a combination of coursework, mentorship, critique, and cross-disciplinary exploration, that culminates in a period of rigorous thesis work, designers hone their practical skills while establishing the foundation of history, theory, and broad cultural literacy to sustain a lifelong artistic and professional practice. With tracks intended for both experienced designers and those new to the discipline, the curriculum in MFA in Graphic Design program at CalArts is based on the Institute’s critical approach of contextualizing praxis in history, theory, and in the Graphic Design program’s inclusive pedagogy.

title: MFA - Photography and Media (CalArts)
tldr: `Master's Program` in Photography and Media of CalArts
info: 매체의 가능성을 확장하고 싶은 예술가를 위해 만들어진 CalArts의 2년제 사진·미디어 MFA는 이미지가 동시대 문화를 어떻게 형성하는지에 관한 비판적 대화에 참여하고, 기술적·형식적 기량을 쌓으며, 독자적인 작업군을 만들도록 장려합니다. 교수 멘토의 지도 아래 대학원생은 비평 이론, 현안, 맥락적 역사를 강조하는 세미나에 참여합니다. 대학원생은 개인 스튜디오에서 작업하고 CalArts의 여러 갤러리에서 전시를 열며 평생 독립적 실천의 토대를 세웁니다. Created for artists who want to expand the possibilities of their media, the two-year MFA in Photography and Media at CalArts encourages students to engage in critical conversations relating to how images shape contemporary culture, build technical and formal skills, and create a distinctive body of work. Guided by faculty mentors, graduate students participate in seminars that emphasize critical theory, current issues, and contextualizing history. Critique classes establish the basis for dialogue about ongoing work among students and rotating faculty members, helping each artist to develop their own criteria and ability to discuss their own and others’ work. Graduate students work in individual studios and mount exhibitions in CalArts’ many galleries, establishing the foundation for a lifelong independent practice. Graduate critiques, seminars, and independent studies with faculty will form the basis of your curriculum as an MFA Photography and Media student. When you arrive at CalArts, you’ll be assigned an individual studio, available to you 24/7, and have access to a wide range of communal labs, shops, and studios. CalArts’ Photo Lab provides equipment check-out and facilities to support both traditional and digital processes.

title: MFA in Studio, Visual Communication Design (SAIC)
tldr: `Master's Program` in Visual Communication Design of SAIC
info: 디자인 사고와 실천에 적극적으로 참여하는 교수진이 이끄는 시각 커뮤니케이션 디자인 학생들은 자신이 만드는 것에 대해 비판적으로 생각하고, 작업에서 위험을 감수하며, 디자인의 가치와 변혁적 힘을 경험하도록 요구받습니다. 저명한 교수진은 자발적·의뢰 기반, 물리적·가상, 개인적·협업적 실천이 공존하는 동시대 디자인 실천·연구·교육의 다양성을 대표합니다. Led by faculty who are actively engaged in design thinking and practice, Visual Communication Design students are challenged to think critically about what they create, take risks in their work, and experience the value and transformative ability of design. Renowned Visual Communication Design faculty represent the diversity of contemporary design practice, research, and pedagogy with thriving practices both self-initiated and client-associated, physical and virtual, and individual and collaborative. Students are presented with a rich array of tools and ideas and work with faculty to broaden and deepen their understanding of the field, acquire new skills and approaches, and develop an innovative and mature body of work. Faculty guide students in self-initiated work that explores issues of personal interest and cultural/social significance.

title: Michael Gericke
tldr: Pentagram 뉴욕 사무소의 파트너, 아이덴티티·환경 그래픽 디자이너
info: Michael Gericke는 그래픽 디자이너이자 Pentagram 뉴욕 사무소의 파트너다. 수많은 상징적 브랜드, 문화 기관, 공공 공간의 시각 언어를 만드는 데 핵심적인 역할을 해 왔다. 아이덴티티 디자인, 브랜딩, 환경 그래픽 작업으로 잘 알려져 있으며, 그의 프로젝트는 표현하려는 대상의 본질을 포착하는 우아한 단순함과 명료함으로 인정받는다. 그의 작업은 널리 보이며 일상 문화의 알아볼 수 있는 일부가 되었다. 그래픽 아트, 스토리텔링, 장소 만들기에 대한 기여는 크며, 체험 디자인 발전을 이끈 주요 인물 중 한 명이다. 디자인계와 시민 기관 양쪽에서 수많은 영예를 받았다. 그의 작업은 국제 전시에 정기적으로 등장하며, 세계 여러 박물관의 영구 소장품에 모범적 디자인의 사례로 포함되어 있다. 그는 디자인, 아이덴티티, 스토리텔링, 건축 환경을 다룬 베스트셀러 《Graphic Life》의 저자다. 그의 수많은 시각·브랜드 아이덴티티에는 MIT와 함께 개발도상국 아이들에게 저렴하고 튼튼한 인터넷 연결 노트북을 보급하는 One Laptop per Child, Public Radio International(PRI), 록펠러 센터, 맨해튼과 뉴어크·JFK 공항을 잇는 AirTrain 시스템이 있다. 그의 브랜딩 작업은 세계 최대 스포츠 행사인 FIFA 월드컵, 대학 간 체육 연맹 Big 10의 로고, 대학 풋볼 챔피언십의 트로피와 비주얼 아이덴티티, 애리조나 카디널스 NFL 경기장의 환경 그래픽과 사이니지, CBS의 동계 올림픽 중계 방송에도 이른다. 문화 프로젝트로는 스미스소니언 쿠퍼 휴이트 국립디자인박물관, 워싱턴 D.C.의 국립미술관, 아부다비 구겐하임 신관이 있다. 교육 분야 작업으로는 매사추세츠주 케임브리지에 넓게 펼쳐진 MIT 캠퍼스의 아이덴티티와 안내 시스템, 맨해튼 루스벨트 아일랜드의 코넬 테크 지구가 있다. Michael과 팀은 미국 최초급의 순 제로 에너지 학교인 뉴욕시 P.S. 62의 그래픽 프로그램을 만들었으며, 이 학교는 소비하는 만큼의 에너지를 생산하도록 설계되었다. 공공 영역에서의 작업도 폭넓다. 뉴욕 모이니핸 스테이션, 허드슨 야즈, 미드타운 맨해튼에서 가장 높은 사무용 타워 원 밴더빌트의 재개발에 기여했다. 국제 프로젝트로는 뭄바이와 토론토 국제공항, 싱가포르 내항의 마리나 베이 샌즈 복합 리조트가 있다. 수십 년 동안 9·11 이후 세계무역센터 부지 재건을 위한 디자인 노력에서 중요한 역할을 맡았다. 그의 디자인에는 SOM이 설계한 서반구에서 가장 높은 건물 원 월드트레이드센터, 타워 2·3·4·7, 산티아고 칼라트라바가 설계한 PATH 복합 교통 터미널의 그래픽 프로그램이 있다. Michael은 아이덴티티와 체험 디자인에서 최고의 가치를 추구하고 이 분야의 방향과 성장에 크게 기여한 공로로 체험 그래픽 디자인 협회(SEGD) 펠로에 선정되었다. 뛰어난 디자인과 직업에 대한 기여로 미국건축가협회의 Harry B. Rutkins Award를 받았다. 모교 위스콘신대학교에서 직업적·시민적 성취로 우수 동문상을 받았고 국제그래픽연맹(AGI) 회원으로 선출되었다. 국립건축박물관 이사이며, Center for Architecture 자문위원회, SEGD 이사회, AIGA에서 활동했다. Michael Gericke is a graphic designer and a partner at Pentagram’s New York office. He has played a pivotal role in shaping the visual language of many iconic brands, cultural institutions, and public spaces. Known for his influential work in identity design, branding, and environmental graphics, his projects are recognized for their elegant simplicity and clarity—often capturing the essential qualities of the object or topic he is representing. His work is widely seen and has become a recognizable part of daily culture. Michael’s contributions to graphic arts, storytelling, and placemaking are significant, making him one of the leading figures in the development of experiential design. He has received numerous accolades from both design and civic institutions. His work appears regularly in international exhibitions and is part of the permanent collections of many museums around the world as examples of exemplary design. He is the author of Graphic Life, a bestselling book on design, identity, storytelling, and the built environment. Among his many visual and brand identities are One Laptop per Child—an initiative with MIT that provides affordable, durable, internet-connected laptops to children in developing countries; Public Radio International (PRI); Rockefeller Center; and the AirTrain systems connecting Manhattan to Newark and JFK International Airports. His branding work also spans the world’s largest sporting event, the FIFA World Cup; the logo for the Big 10 intercollegiate athletic conference; the trophy and visual identity for the College Football Championship; the environmental graphics and signage for the Arizona Cardinals NFL stadium; and CBS’s television coverage of the Winter Olympic Games. Michael’s cultural projects include the Smithsonian’s Cooper Hewitt National Design Museum, Washington, D.C.’s National Gallery of Art, and the Guggenheim’s new museum in Abu Dhabi. His educational work includes the identity and orientation system for MIT’s sprawling Cambridge, Massachusetts campus and Cornell University’s new Cornell Tech district on Manhattan’s Roosevelt Island. Michael and his team created the graphic program for P.S. 62—New York City’s inaugural net-zero-energy school, one of the first in the United States—designed to generate as much energy as it consumes. His public realm work is far-reaching. He has contributed to the redevelopment of New York City’s Moynihan Station, Hudson Yards, and One Vanderbilt, Midtown Manhattan’s tallest office tower. His iconic international projects include Mumbai’s and Toronto’s international airports, and the Marina Bay Sands integrated resort on Singapore’s inner harbor. For decades, he has played a significant role in the design efforts to rebuild the World Trade Center site following September 11. His designs include graphic programs for One World Trade Center—the tallest building in the Western Hemisphere, by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill—as well as Towers Two, Three, Four, and Seven, and the PATH intermodal terminal designed by Santiago Calatrava. Michael was named a Fellow of the Society for Experiential Graphic Design for promoting the highest values in identity and experiential design and for significantly contributing to the direction and growth of the field. He is the recipient of the American Institute of Architects’ Harry B. Rutkins Award for his outstanding design and contributions to the profession. He received the Distinguished Alumni Award for his professional and civic achievements from his alma mater, the University of Wisconsin, and was elected a member of Alliance Graphique Internationale (AGI). He is a trustee of the National Building Museum, and has served on the Advisory Council of the Center for Architecture, the Board of Directors of the Society for Experiential Graphic Design (SEGD), and the American Institute of Graphic Arts (AIGA).
